```{r}
# Load scaling function, quickly has option to scale from 0-1 and truncate
quickscale <- function(data, percentile = 0.99, na.rm = T) {
  highlim <- quantile(data, percentile, na.rm = na.rm)
  lowlim <- quantile(data, 1 - percentile, na.rm = na.rm)
  data <- (data - lowlim) / (highlim - lowlim)
  data[data < 0] <- 0
  data[data > 1] <- 1
  return(data)
}

# quick function to chop off  data by percentile or exact number, don't remember why i made this, scales::oob_censor works well enough probably
censor <- function(data, percentile = 0.99, cap = NA) {
  data <- as.matrix(data)
  if (is.na(cap)) {
    highlim <- quantile(data, percentile)
  } else {
    highlim <- cap
  }
  lowlim <- quantile(data, 1 - percentile)
  data[data < lowlim] <- lowlim
  data[data > highlim] <- highlim
  return(as.data.table(data))
}
# Slightly faster version of Rphenograph
Rphenographslim <- function(data, k = 30) {
  neighborMatrix <- RANN::nn2(data, data, k + 1, searchtype = "standard")[[1]][, -1]
  links <- Rphenograph:::jaccard_coeff(neighborMatrix)
  links <- links[links[, 1] > 0, ]
  relations <- as.data.frame(links)
  colnames(relations) <- c("from", "to", "weight")
  g <- igraph::graph.data.frame(relations, directed = FALSE)
  community <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g)
  return(community)
}

# If Rphenograph leaves out cells, increases k until all cells get a label
Rphenographiterator <- function(data, k) {
  set.seed(87)
  loop <- T
  while (loop == T) {
    Rpheno <- Rphenographslim(data, k)
    if (length(Rpheno$membership) < nrow(data)) {
      k <- k + 2
    } else {
      loop <- F
    }
  }
  return(Rpheno)
}

# quick calculation for entropy
Entropycalc <- function(data) {
  probs <- data / sum(data)
  return(sum(sapply(probs, function(x) -x * log(x))))
}

# hacked together way to label edge cells, i guess first coding challenge is to reverse engineer/explain this
edgedetection <- function(inputset, k = 10, limit = 0.3, Spreadk = 5, Spreadlimit = "AUTO") {
  # get midpoints of the image
  midX <- (max(inputset$jm) - min(inputset$jm)) / 2
  midY <- (max(inputset$im) - min(inputset$im)) / 2

  # generate data structures
  X <- ppp(
    x = inputset[, jm],
    y = inputset[, im],
    window = owin(
      c(
        inputset[, min(jm)],
        inputset[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        inputset[, min(im)],
        inputset[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )
  Y <- ppp(
    x = midX,
    y = midY,
    window = owin(
      c(
        inputset[, min(jm)],
        inputset[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        inputset[, min(im)],
        inputset[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )
  # i forget, will have to test
  Z <- crossdist(Y, X)[1, ]

  # get certain number of nearest neighbors probably
  NNs <- nnwhich(X, k = 1:k)
  edgeindex <- vector("logical", nrow(inputset))

  # for each cell, i think this removes single cell artifacts
  for (i in 1:length(edgeindex)) {
    edgeindex[i] <- sum(Z[NNs[i, ]] > Z[i]) < k * limit
  }

  # looking at only real tissue cells ?
  XX <- ppp(
    x = inputset[edgeindex, jm],
    y = inputset[edgeindex, im],
    window = owin(
      c(
        inputset[, min(jm)],
        inputset[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        inputset[, min(im)],
        inputset[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )

  # one hemisphere at a time? i don't even remember why this works
  hemi <- inputset[edgeindex, im] > midY
  angles <- atan((inputset[edgeindex, im] - midY) / (inputset[edgeindex, jm] - midX))
  ZZ <- crossdist(Y, XX)[1, ]
  NNXXs <- nnwhich(XX, k = 1:Spreadk)
  NNrange <- vector("numeric", length(ZZ))
  for (i in 1:length(NNrange)) {
    NNrange[i] <- diff(range(ZZ[NNXXs[i, ]]))
  }
  NNray <- vector("numeric", length(ZZ))
  for (i in 1:length(NNray)) {
    NNray[i] <- max(ZZ[which(abs(angles - angles[i]) < 0.03 & hemi == hemi[i])])
  }

  if (Spreadlimit == "Auto") {
    Spreadlimit <- mean(NNrange) + 1.5 * sd(NNrange)
  }

  orphanindex <- NNrange > Spreadlimit | 0.95 * NNray > ZZ

  edgeindex[which(edgeindex)[orphanindex]] <- F
  edgeindex
}

# Quicker way to plot graphs that fit a certain format, heavily dependent on variable names though
ROIplot <- function(x, plotsub, marker, qualquant = "qual", label = NULL, shapetype = 16) {
  ggout <- ggplot(x[ROI == plotsub], aes(
    x = jm, y = -im,
    color = get(marker)
  )) +
    geom_point(shape = shapetype) +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(color = label) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
      shape = 20,
      size = 3
    )))
  if (qualquant == "qual") {
    ggout <- ggout + scale_color_manual(values = colormap)
  }
  if (qualquant == "quant") {
    ggout <- ggout + scale_color_viridis(option = "H")
  }
  if (is.null(label)) {
    ggout <- ggout + theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank()
    )
  }
  return(ggout)
}

# Quick heatmap generator, quicker than pheatmap which seems to only take matrices, not data.tables
heatmapwrap <- function(
  datainput,
  columns,
  rows,
  title = NA,
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    1,
    0.01
  ),
  scale_all = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  cluster_rows = T,
  display_numbers = F,
  scaled = NA,
  rankby = NA,
  annotation_row = NA,
  annotation_colors = NA,
  col_labels = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  legend = T,
  fontsize = 12, transpose = FALSE, angle_col = "270"
) {
  if (is.na(title)) {
    title <- paste(deparse(substitute(datainput)), collapse = " ")
  }

  heatmap_data <- datainput[, lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)), by = rows, .SDcols = columns]
  heatmap_counts <- datainput[, .N, by = rows]

  heatmap_data <- merge(heatmap_data, heatmap_counts, by = rows)

  heatmap_data[, percentage := N / sum(N)]
  heatmap_data[
    ,
    percentageoutput := paste0(
      paste(get(rows),
        format(100 * percentage,
          digits = 2
        ),
        sep = ":"
      ),
      "%"
    )
  ]
  if (scale_all) {
    heatmap_data[, (columns) := lapply(.SD, function(x) quickscale(x, 1)), .SDcols = columns]
  }
  if (!is.na(scaled)) {
    heatmap_data[, (scaled) := lapply(.SD, function(x) quickscale(x, 1)), .SDcols = scaled]
  }
  if (!is.na(rankby)) {
    cluster_rows <- F
    neworder <- order(heatmap_data[[rankby]])
    heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[neworder]
  }
  plotdata <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, ..columns])
  rownames(plotdata) <- heatmap_data[[rows]]
  labels_col <- colnames(plotdata)
  if (!is.null(col_labels)) {
    if (!is.null(names(col_labels))) {
      tmp <- col_labels[colnames(plotdata)]
      labels_col <- ifelse(is.na(tmp), labels_col, tmp) # fallback to originals
    } else if (length(col_labels) == ncol(plotdata)) {
      labels_col <- col_labels
    } else stop("col_labels must be a named vector or have length ncol(plotdata).")
  }

  # rows (y-axis)
  labels_row <- heatmap_data[, percentageoutput]
  if (!is.null(row_labels)) {
    if (!is.null(names(row_labels))) {
      tmp <- row_labels[rownames(plotdata)]
      labels_row <- ifelse(is.na(tmp), labels_row, tmp)
    } else if (length(row_labels) == nrow(plotdata)) {
      labels_row <- row_labels
    } else stop("row_labels must be a named vector or have length nrow(plotdata).")
  }
  # Resolve labels against the original matrix before swapping axes.
  annotation_col <- NA
  if (transpose) {
    plotdata <- t(plotdata)
    original_labels_row <- labels_row
    labels_row <- labels_col
    labels_col <- original_labels_row
    original_cluster_rows <- cluster_rows
    cluster_rows <- cluster_cols
    cluster_cols <- original_cluster_rows
    annotation_col <- annotation_row
    annotation_row <- NA
    if (is.matrix(display_numbers)) display_numbers <- t(display_numbers)
  }
  return(pheatmap(plotdata,
    labels_row = labels_row,
    labels_col = labels_col,
    cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
    cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
    breaks = breaks,
    main = title,
    display_numbers = display_numbers,
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    legend = legend,
    fontsize = fontsize, angle_col = angle_col
  ))
}

# Don't use this often but a single cell heatmap to see if intercluster heterogeneity is bad
heatmapwrapsinglecell <- function(datainput, columns, rows, clustering = NA, legend = T, title = NA, scaled = NA) {
  if (is.na(clustering)) {
    if (is.na(title)) {
      title <- deparse(substitute(datainput))
    }
    if (!is.na(scaled)) {
      datainput[, (scaled) := lapply(.SD, function(x) quickscale(x, 1)), .SDcols = scaled]
    }
    outheat <- data.frame(as.matrix(datainput[, ..columns]), row.names = 1:nrow(datainput))
    annotation_data <- datainput[, ..rows]
    return(pheatmap(outheat,
      show_rownames = F,
      annotation_row = annotation_data,
      cluster_cols = F,
      legend = legend,
      annotation_legend = legend
    ))
  } else {
    outheat <- data.frame(
      as.matrix(datainput[
        order(datainput[[clustering]]),
        ..columns
      ]),
      row.names = 1:nrow(datainput)
    )
    annotation_data <- datainput[order(datainput[[clustering]]), ..rows]
    return(pheatmap(outheat,
      show_rownames = F,
      annotation_row = annotation_data,
      cluster_cols = F,
      cluster_rows = F,
      legend = legend,
      annotation_legend = legend,
      main = title
    ))
  }
}

# Quick UMAP, almost never use this
umapwrap <- function(datainput, columns, rows, k = 30) {
  breakline <- T
  if (nrow(datainput) > 50000) {
    breakline <- as.logical(readline(paste0(nrow(datainput), " cells, proceed? T or F")))
  }
  if (breakline == T) {
    set.seed(1234)
    data_umap <- umap(datainput[, ..columns], k)
    datainput[, c("umapx", "umapy") := split(data_umap, rep(1:ncol(data_umap), each = nrow(data_umap)))]
    ggplot(datainput) +
      geom_point(aes(x = umapx, y = umapy, color = factor(get(rows)))) +
      geom_label(
        data = datainput[,
          lapply(
            .SD,
            mean
          ),
          by = rows,
          .SDcols = c(
            "umapx",
            "umapy"
          )
        ],
        aes(
          x = umapx,
          y = umapy,
          color = factor(get(rows)),
          label = gsub(
            "meta_core_",
            "",
            get(rows)
          )
        ),
        alpha = 0.8,
        nudge_x = 0.5,
        nudge_y = 0.5
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  }
}

# To help iterators, this seems to change often but I think it still works
isplitDT <- function(x, colname, vals) {
  colname <- as.name(colname)
  ival <- iter(vals)
  nextEl <- function() {
    val <- nextElem(ival)
    list(value = eval(bquote(x[.(colname) == .(val)])), key = val)
  }
  obj <- list(nextElem = nextEl)
  class(obj) <- c('abstractiter', 'iter')
  obj
}

# Counter to see how fast things are going
progresstrack <- function(position, list, history) {
  out <- floor(10 * which(list == position) / length(list))
  if (out != history) {
    cat(paste0(out, "0%..."))
  }
  return(out)
}

# Little bit more info on heatmap
ggplotheatmap_percentages <- function(
  data,
  markers,
  groups,
  fun = mean,
  ytitle = groups,
  hclust = NULL,
  midpoint = 0.5
) {
  if (!is.factor(data[[groups]])) {
    data[, (groups) := factor(data[[groups]])]
  }

  if (!is.null(hclust)) {
    newlabelorder <- hclust(dist(data[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = markers, by = groups][, -1]))$order
    data[[groups]] <- factor(data[[groups]], levels = levels(data[[groups]])[newlabelorder])
  }
  heatmapdata <- melt(
    data[,
      lapply(
        .SD,
        fun
      ),
      .SDcols = markers,
      by = groups
    ],
    measure.vars = markers,
    id.vars = NULL
  )
  heatmappercentages <- round(data[, .N, by = groups]$N / nrow(data), 4) * 100
  heatmaplabels <- paste(levels(data[[groups]]), paste0(heatmappercentages, "%"), sep = ":")

  p <- ggplot(heatmapdata, aes(x = variable, y = get(groups), fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    labs(y = ytitle, title = groups) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#075AFF", mid = "#FFFFCC", high = "#FF0000", midpoint = midpoint, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        vjust = 1,
        hjust = 1
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = heatmaplabels) +
    coord_fixed()
  return(p)
}

# Don't remember using this
plotTable = function(
  x,
  colInd = 1:3,
  digits = 3,
  theme = ggplot2::theme_get(),
  header = NULL,
  row.names.y = NULL
) {
  text_size_adjust <- (1 / 72.27) * 25.4
  if (is.null(row.names.y))
    row.names.y <- rownames(x)
  if (is.vector(header) && length(header) == length(columns)) {} else {
    header = c("Est.", "2.5 %", "97.5 %")
  }
  ggplot2::theme_set(theme)
  if (!is.data.frame(x))
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  tableplot <- ggplot2::ggplot(x, ggplot2::aes(y = rownames(x))) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(position = "top", name = NULL, labels = header, breaks = colnames(x[, colInd]))
  tableplot <- tableplot + ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = colnames(x)[colInd[1]],
      label = round(
        x[
          ,
          colInd[1]
        ],
        digits
      )
    ),
    color = theme$text$colour,
    size = theme$text$size * text_size_adjust,
    family = theme$text$family
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = colnames(x)[colInd[2]],
        label = round(
          x[
            ,
            colInd[2]
          ],
          digits
        )
      ),
      color = theme$text$colour,
      size = theme$text$size * text_size_adjust,
      family = theme$text$family
    ) + ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = colnames(x)[colInd[3]],
        label = round(
          x[
            ,
            colInd[3]
          ],
          digits
        )
      ),
      color = theme$text$colour,
      size = theme$text$size * text_size_adjust,
      family = theme$text$family
    )
  tableplot <- tableplot + ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(rownames(x)), labels = rev(row.names.y)) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 1), axis.text = theme$text,
      plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "lines")
    )
  invisible(tableplot)
}

# These are complicated functions that aren't currently in use, but they're for biostats
log10forestPlot = function(
  resultIn,
  HRvsORplot = FALSE,
  effInds = c(1:3),
  shape = 19,
  limits = NULL,
  breaks = c(
    0.5,
    1,
    1.5,
    2,
    3,
    4
  ),
  header = NULL, row.names.y = NULL
) {
  ## resultIn: data matrix or data frame
  ## default is for odds ratio plot, scaled in log10, but show odds ratio
  ## when HRvsORplot = TRUE, this is for hazard ratio plot, scaled in log10, but show hazard ratio
  ## effIds are the 3 columns data for forest plot, value, 95% lower bound, and 95% upper bound
  resultIn = data.frame(resultIn, stringsAsFactors = F)
  colnames(resultIn)[effInds[1]] = "effect_val"
  colnames(resultIn)[effInds[2]] = "lower_val"
  colnames(resultIn)[effInds[3]] = "upper_val"

  # ### order by effect_val
  # resultIn = resultIn[order(resultIn$effect_val, decreasing = TRUE),]
  resultIn$varsIn = rownames(resultIn)
  resultIn$varsIn = factor(resultIn$varsIn, levels = rev(resultIn$varsIn))

  themes = theme_get()
  p = ggplot(resultIn, aes(x = varsIn, y = effect_val, ymin = lower_val, ymax = upper_val)) +
    geom_pointrange(colour = "black", shape = shape) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, lty = 2) +
    coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_y_log10(breaks = breaks, position = "right", limits = limits) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = themes$text,
      plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "lines")
    )

  titleIn = NA
  if (HRvsORplot) {
    titleIn = "Hazard Ratio"
  } else {
    titleIn = "Odds Ratio"
  }
  tableplot = plotTable(x = resultIn, colInd = effInds)
  forestplot = join_ggplots(tableplot, p, plot.widths = c(0.5, 0.5), title = titleIn)
  invisible(forestplot)
}

) {

# Same
coxVarSelectionLASSO_plus = function(
  dat,
  survTime,
  survEvent,
  VarNames,
  patientID = "TMA_ID",
  filename = "default",
  title = "default", topN = 10, forestHeight = 4
) {
  pid = dat[, patientID]
  morevar = c(survTime, survEvent)
  fdat = dat[, morevar]
  dat = dat[, VarNames]

  ### remove variables if their sd < 0.00001
  sdcol = apply(dat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

  sdtmp = which(sdcol > 0.00001)
  dat = dat[, sdtmp]
  vars = intersect(VarNames, colnames(dat))

  dat = cbind(fdat, dat)

  ### remove NA for Y side if there are any
  natmp1 = which(is.na(dat[[survTime]]))
  natmp2 = which(is.na(dat[[survEvent]]))
  natmp = unique(c(natmp1, natmp2))
  if (length(natmp) > 0) {
    dat = dat[-natmp, ]
  }

  surdat = data.matrix(dat[, morevar])
  surObj = Surv(surdat[, 1], surdat[, 2])

  ## clean up
  rm(surdat)

  lassoF = glmnet(x = data.matrix(dat[, vars]), y = surObj, family = "cox")
  allcoefs = data.matrix(lassoF$beta)

  ######################################################
  ### more output for LASSO on 0827
  outfile = paste0("cox_", topN, "_N_", filename, "_", title)
  lassoPlot = paste0(outfile, "_LASSO.pdf")
  lassoCoef = gsub("pdf", "csv", lassoPlot)

  pdf(lassoPlot)
  plot(lassoF)
  # plotres(lassoF)
  plot(lassoF, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
  dev.off()

  ####################################################

  ### clean up
  rm(surObj)

  ## calculate how many variables are remained, and a0 is in a different output
  coef01 = apply(allcoefs, c(1, 2), FUN = function(xx) {
    ifelse(abs(xx) > 0.00001, 1, 0)
  })
  csum = colSums(coef01)

  tt = csum[duplicated(csum)]

  ### to find who close to top N
  tmp = which.min(abs(tt - topN)) ### it gives the 1st matching

  ### now, find lambda for this tmp
  scoefs = allcoefs[, names(tmp)]

  #############################
  ## write out all coefs and lambda as well on 0827
  colnames(allcoefs) = paste(colnames(allcoefs), lassoF$lambda, sep = "_lambda")
  write.csv(allcoefs, lassoCoef)

  ### write out scoefs, 20220204
  write.csv(scoefs, paste0("LASSOselected_", lassoCoef))

  ##############################
  ### get out the variable names whose coefs are not 0
  topnsh = which(abs(scoefs) > 0.00001)

  ### get variable names only
  topnsh = names(topnsh) ### this is the variable list from LASSO

  survY = paste0("Surv(`", morevar[1], "`,`", morevar[2], "`)")

  ################# note on 20220608###################################
  ### this part was added on 0504, however, this should not change the final results
  survX = paste(topnsh, collapse = " + ")

  fitsh = coxph(as.formula(paste(survY, survX, sep = " ~ ")), data = dat)

  afitsh = coxphOutput(fitsh, isWeighted = FALSE)
  outfile = paste0("cox_", topN, "_N_", filename, "_", title)
  outfile1sh = paste0(outfile, "LASSO.csv")
  outfile2sh = paste0(outfile, "LASSOforest.pdf")

  afit1sh = afitsh[order(afitsh[, 2], decreasing = TRUE), ]

  write.csv(afit1sh, outfile1sh)

  pdf(outfile2sh, width = 13, height = forestHeight)
  ### add more plots on 0827 -> 0830, however bit is not so good, the 2nd plot is too wide
  log10forestPlot(resultIn = afit1sh, HRvsORplot = TRUE, effInds = 2:4, breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 10))
  dev.off()
  ################################################

  ###############################################################################
  ###################### the above are customized LASSO results ################
  ###############################################################################

  ### now, let's try to use single variable approach
  # survY = paste0("Surv(", morevar[1],",", morevar[2], ")")  ## this is duplicated, and should remove
  cox1out = t(sapply(vars, function(var1) {
    out1 = coxph(as.formula(paste(survY, var1, sep = " ~ ")), data = dat)
    return(summary(out1)$coefficients)
  }))

  colnames(cox1out) = c("coef", "exp(coef)", "se(coef)", "z", "p")
  ### get FDR
  cox1out = data.frame(cox1out)
  cox1out$adjusteP = p.adjust(cox1out$p, method = "BH")

  ### order them and write out
  cox1out = cox1out[order(cox1out$adjusteP), ]
  ## cutoff, FDR < 0.05
  cox1out = subset(cox1out, cox1out$adjusteP <= 0.05)
  if (dim(cox1out)[1] > 0) {
    cox1out = head(cox1out, n = topN)
    write.csv(cox1out, gsub("LASSO", "singleVar", lassoCoef))
  }

  topn2 = rownames(cox1out)

  ### combine topn1 and topn2, run a full model and step
  topn1 = union(topnsh, topn2)

  survX = paste(topn1, collapse = " + ")

  fit1 = coxph(as.formula(paste(survY, survX, sep = " ~ ")), data = dat)

  ###########################################################
  ####### the following are LASSO_plus outputs ################

  fit2 = step(fit1, trace = F)

  afit1 = coxphOutput(fit2)

  outfile1 = paste0(outfile, "LASSO_plus.csv")
  outfile2 = paste0(outfile, "LASSO_plus_forest.pdf")

  afit1 = afit1[order(afit1[, 2], decreasing = TRUE), ]

  write.csv(afit1, outfile1)

  pdf(outfile2, width = 13, height = forestHeight + 1)
  log10forestPlot(resultIn = afit1, HRvsORplot = TRUE, effInds = 2:4, breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 10))
  dev.off()

  ### re-run fit1 based on variables in fit2
  survX = paste(rownames(afit1), collapse = " + ")
  fit1 = coxph(as.formula(paste(survY, survX, sep = " ~ ")), data = dat)
  ### return
  return(list(vif(fit1), cox.zph(fit1), afit1))
}

# Same
binaryVarSelectionLASSO_plus = function(dat, y01, VarNames, patientID = "TMA_ID", filename = "default",
                                        title = "default", topN = 10, forestHeight = 4) {
  pid = dat[, patientID]
  morevar = c(y01)
  fdat = dat[, morevar]
  dat = dat[, VarNames]

  # ### remove variables if their sd < 0.0000001
  sdcol = apply(dat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdtmp = which(sdcol > 0.0000001)
  dat = dat[, sdtmp]

  vars = intersect(VarNames, colnames(dat))
  dat = cbind(fdat, dat)

  ### remove NA for Y side if there are any
  natmp = which(is.na(dat$fdat))

  if (length(natmp) > 0) {
    dat = dat[-natmp, ]
  }

  lassoF = glmnet(x = data.matrix(dat[, vars]), y = as.integer(dat$fdat), family = "binomial")

  allcoefs = data.matrix(lassoF$beta)

  ######################################################
  ### more output for LASSO on 0827
  outfile = paste0("glm_", topN, "_N_", filename, "_", title)
  lassoPlot = paste0(outfile, "_LASSO.pdf")
  lassoCoef = gsub("pdf", "csv", lassoPlot)

  pdf(lassoPlot)
  plot(lassoF)
  # plotres(lassoF)
  plot(lassoF, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
  dev.off()

  ####################################################

  ## calculate how many variables are remained, and a0 is in a different output
  coef01 = apply(allcoefs, c(1, 2), FUN = function(xx) {
    ifelse(abs(xx) > 0.00001, 1, 0)
  })
  csum = colSums(coef01)

  tt = csum[duplicated(csum)]

  ### to find who close to top N
  tmp = which.min(abs(tt - topN)) ### it gives the 1st matching

  ### now, find lambda for this tmp
  scoefs = allcoefs[, names(tmp)]

  #############################
  ## write out all coefs and lambda as well on 0827
  colnames(allcoefs) = paste(colnames(allcoefs), lassoF$lambda, sep = "_lambda")
  write.csv(allcoefs, lassoCoef)

  ### write out scoefs, 20220204
  write.csv(scoefs, paste0("LASSOselected_", lassoCoef))

  ##############################
  ### get out the variable names whose coefs are not 0
  topnsh = which(abs(scoefs) > 0.00001)

  ### get variable names only
  topnsh = names(topnsh) ### this is the variable list from LASSO

  f1 = as.formula(paste("fdat", paste(topnsh, collapse = " + "), sep = " ~ "))

  fit1 = glm(formula = f1, family = "binomial", data = dat)

  topnsh <- topnsh[which(!is.na(fit1$coefficients)[-1])]

  f1 = as.formula(paste("fdat", paste(topnsh, collapse = " + "), sep = " ~ "))

  fit1 = glm(formula = f1, family = "binomial", data = dat)

  if (!any(is.na(coef(fit1)))) {
    out1 = summary(fit1)$coef
    out2 = exp(cbind("Odds_ratio" = coef(fit1), confint.default(fit1, level = 0.95)))

    fitout = cbind(out1, out2)

    ### remove intercept, order by odds ratio
    fitout = fitout[-1, ]

    fitout = fitout[order(fitout[, 5], decreasing = TRUE), ]

    outfile = paste0(topN, "_N_", y01, "_", filename, "_", title)
    outfile1 = paste0(outfile, "logodds.pdf")

    pdf(outfile1, width = 13, height = forestHeight)
    log10forestPlot(resultIn = fitout, effInds = 5:7, breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 10))
    dev.off()

    outfile2 = paste0(outfile, "_glm.csv")
    write.csv(fitout, outfile2)

    ### model score
    modelScore = predict(fit1, newdata = dat, type = "response")
    ### should add modelScore with other info
    modelScore = cbind(fdat, pid, modelScore)
    colnames(modelScore) = c(y01, patientID, "Model_score")
    write.csv(modelScore, gsub("glm", "modelScore", outfile2))

    ###############################################################################
    ###################### the above are customized LASSO results ################
    ###############################################################################

    ### now, let's try to use single variable approach
    # survY = paste0("Surv(", morevar[1],",", morevar[2], ")")  ## this is duplicated, and should remove
    bout = t(sapply(vars, function(var1) {
      out1 = glm(as.formula(paste("fdat", var1, sep = " ~ ")), family = "binomial", data = dat)
      return(summary(out1)$coefficients[2, ])
    }))

    colnames(bout) = c("coef", "se(coef)", "z", "p")
    ### get FDR
    bout = data.frame(bout)
    bout$adjusteP = p.adjust(bout$p, method = "BH")

    ### order them and write out
    bout = bout[order(bout$adjusteP), ]
    ## cutoff, FDR < 0.05
    bout = subset(bout, bout$adjusteP <= 0.05)
    if (dim(bout)[1] > 0) {
      bout = head(bout, n = topN)
      write.csv(bout, gsub("LASSO", "singleVar", lassoCoef))
    }
    topn2 = rownames(bout)

    ### combine topn1 and topn2, run a full model and step
    topn1 = union(topnsh, topn2)

    vX = paste(topn1, collapse = " + ")

    fit1 = glm(as.formula(paste("fdat", vX, sep = " ~ ")), family = "binomial", data = dat)

    ###########################################################
    ####### the following are LASSO_plus outputs ################

    fit2 = step(fit1, trace = F)

    afit1 = summary(fit2)$coef
    ## I need odds ratio as well
    afit2 = exp(cbind("Odds_ratio" = coef(fit2), confint.default(fit2, level = 0.95)))

    fitout = cbind(afit1, afit2)

    ### remove intercept, order by odds ratio
    fitout = fitout[-1, ]

    fitout = fitout[order(fitout[, 5], decreasing = TRUE), ]

    outfile1 = paste0(outfile, "LASSO_plus.csv")
    outfile2 = paste0(outfile, "LASSO_plus_forest.pdf")

    write.csv(fitout, outfile1)

    pdf(outfile2, width = 13, height = forestHeight)
    log10forestPlot(resultIn = fitout, HRvsORplot = FALSE, effInds = 5:7, breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 10))
    dev.off()

    ### re-run fit1 based on variables in fit2
    vX = paste(rownames(fitout), collapse = " + ")
    fit1 = glm(as.formula(paste("fdat", vX, sep = " ~ ")), family = "binomial", data = dat)

    ## model checking
    fpdf = gsub("forest", "ModelCheck", outfile2)
    pdf(fpdf, width = 8, height = 8)
    plotGlm(fit1)
    dev.off()

    ### return
    return(list(vif(fit1), fitout))
  }
}

# This is a permutation test, to see if a spatial feature is occurring more than expected
pvaluetestrosette <- function(
  testROI,
  celltypekeep,
  celltypescramble,
  rosettecutoff = 3,
  rosettemax = 15,
  iterations = 100
) {
  pvaluetestcols <- c("ci", "jm", "im", celltypekeep, celltypescramble)

  testROI <- testROI[, ..pvaluetestcols]

  testROI[, paste0(celltypescramble, "_rep") := get(celltypescramble)]

  keepindex <- testROI[[celltypekeep]] == 1
  keepcells <- ppp(
    x = testROI[keepindex]$jm,
    y = testROI[keepindex]$im,
    window = owin(
      c(
        testROI[, min(jm)],
        testROI[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        testROI[, min(im)],
        testROI[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    marks = testROI[keepindex]$ci,
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )

  allcells <- ppp(
    x = testROI$jm,
    y = testROI$im,
    window = owin(
      c(
        testROI[, min(jm)],
        testROI[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        testROI[, min(im)],
        testROI[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    marks = testROI$ci,
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )

  crossmatrix <- nncross(keepcells, allcells,
    k = 1:rosettemax,
    iX = as.integer(testROI[keepindex]$ci),
    iY = as.integer(testROI$ci)
  )

  crossmatrix[, ((rosettemax + 1):(2 * rosettemax))][crossmatrix[, 1:rosettemax] > 15] <- NA

  crossmatch <- crossmatrix[, ((rosettemax + 1):(2 * rosettemax))]

  crosshits <- crossmatch
  crosshits[] <- testROI[[celltypescramble]][unlist(crossmatch)]
  observed <- length(which(rowSums(crosshits, na.rm = T) > rosettecutoff))

  matchingindex <- testROI[[celltypescramble]]
  matchingmatrix <- t(crossmatch)

  outputvalues <- data.table(index = 1:iterations, value = rep(1, iterations))
  outputvalues[,
    value := length(which(colSums(
      matrix(sample(matchingindex)[matchingmatrix],
        nrow = 15
      ),
      na.rm = T
    ) > rosettecutoff)) * value,
    by = index
  ]

  p <- ecdf(outputvalues$value)(observed - 1)

  return(c(observed, p))
}
```

```{r spillover compensation}
raw <- copy(data_in)

spilldata <- raw[, .(CD31, aSMA, Object, ROI)]

# quantiles <- c("CD31" = 0.999,"aSMA"= 0.999)

# hexbin

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 140), ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 500) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +

# density

ggplot(spilldata, aes(x = aSMA, y = CD31)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 140), ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) +
  geom_density_2d(color = "blue", size = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Scatterplot with 2D Density Contours")

corrected <- spilldata[!((CD31 > 0.8 & aSMA < 6) | (CD31 > 3) | (CD31 > 1 & aSMA < 8))]
EC <- spilldata[(CD31 > 0.8 & aSMA < 6) | (CD31 > 3) | (CD31 > 1 & aSMA < 8)]
ggplot(corrected, aes(x = aSMA, y = CD31, )) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 35), ylim = c(0, 3.5)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 500) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "aSMA Intensity", y = "CD31 Intensity",
    title = "Hex-Binned CD31&aSMA Scatter Plot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Step 2: Define bins for the primary channel (x-axis)
number_of_bins <- 1000
corrected$bins <- cut(corrected$CD31, breaks = number_of_bins)

# Step 3: Calculate mean intensity in each bin

mean_data <- corrected %>%
  group_by(bins) %>%
  summarize(
    primary_mean = mean(aSMA),
    secondary_mean = mean(CD31)
  )
ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = primary_mean, y = secondary_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal()

# Step 4: Perform linear regression (fit to mean values)
fit <- lm(secondary_mean ~ primary_mean, data = mean_data)

# Show regression summary
summary(fit)

# Extract slope (spillover factor) and intercept
spillover_factor <- coef(fit)[2]
intercept <- coef(fit)[1]

cat("Spillover factor (slope):", spillover_factor, "\n")
cat("Intercept:", intercept, "\n")

# Step 5: Correct the secondary channel by removing spillover
corrected1 <- rbind(corrected, EC, fill = TRUE)[order(ROI, Object)]
# corrected1[,secondary_corrected := NULL]
corrected1$CD31_corrected <- corrected1$CD31 - spillover_factor * corrected1$aSMA

corrected1$CD31_corrected[corrected1$CD31_corrected < 0] <- 0

# Plot to visualize before and after compensation
par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) # arrange the plor to 1 row 2 cols
ggplot(corrected1, aes(x = aSMA, y = CD31_corrected)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 70), ylim = c(0, 3.5)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
```

```{r Scaling}
quickscale <- function(data, percentile = 0.99, na.rm = T) {
  highlim <- quantile(data, percentile, na.rm = na.rm)
  lowlim <- quantile(data, 1 - percentile, na.rm = na.rm)
  data <- (data - lowlim) / (highlim - lowlim)
  data[data < 0] <- 0
  data[data > 1] <- 1
  return(data)
}

censor <- function(data, percentile = 0.99, cap = NA) {
  data <- as.matrix(data)
  if (is.na(cap)) {
    highlim <- quantile(data, percentile)
  } else {
    highlim <- cap
  }
  lowlim <- quantile(data, 1 - percentile)
  data[data < lowlim] <- lowlim
  data[data > highlim] <- highlim
  return(as.data.table(data))
}
```

```{r Phenograph}
# Select phenograph level: "all" or a specific variable (patient, ROI, etc)
phenographlevel <- "all"
k <- 15

if (phenographlevel == "all") {
  Rmajorpheno <- Rphenographiterator(data_in[, ..corephenotypingmarkers], k)
  # .. tell data table to look for a variable, if there is no"..", datatable will look for a column names"corephenotypingmarkers"
  data_in[
    ,
    core_phenograph := paste0(
      "core_",
      Rmajorpheno$membership
    )
  ] # := (by-reference assignment) add a new col called "core_phenograph" in data_in by concatenating the string "core_" with each element of Rmajorpheno$membership
} else {
  # list of patients
  phenographfactors <- unique(data_in[[phenographlevel]])

  # Initialize column for phenographs
  # data_in[,"meta_core_phenograph" := factor()]

  # Add phenograph clusters for each patient core to data table
  majorphenographphenos <- vector("list", length(phenographfactors))
  # majorphenographiterator <- isplit(data_in, data_in[[phenographlevel]])
  c1 <- makeCluster(cores)
  registerDoParallel(c1)
  Rmajorphenos <- foreach(
    ROIdat = isplitDT(
      data_in,
      phenographlevel,
      unique(data_in[[phenographlevel]])
    ),
    .packages = c(
      "Rcpp",
      "Rphenograph",
      "data.table"
    ),
    .export = "corephenotypingmarkers"
  ) %dopar% {
    paste0("meta_core_", Rphenographiterator(ROIdat$value[, ..corephenotypingmarkers], k)$membership)
  }
  stopCluster(c1)

  for (phenolevel in 1:length(phenographfactors)) {
    set(data_in,
      i = which(data_in[[phenographlevel]] == levels(data_in[[phenographlevel]])[phenolevel]),
      "meta_core_phenograph",
      Rmajorphenos[[phenolevel]]
    )
  }

  data_in[, meta_core_phenograph := factor(meta_core_phenograph, levels = unique(meta_core_phenograph))]

  # Find the median expression level of each ROI phenograph cluster
  meta_data_in <- data_in[,
    lapply(
      .SD,
      median
    ),
    by = c(
      phenographlevel,
      "meta_core_phenograph"
    ),
    .SDcols = c(
      panel_proteins,
      morphologymarkers
    )
  ]

  meta_data_counts <- data_in[, .N, by = .(get(phenographlevel), meta_core_phenograph)]

  n <- 5

  meta_phenograph <- Rphenographiterator(meta_data_in[, ..corephenotypingmarkers], n)

  meta_data_in_z <- copy(meta_data_in)[,
    (panel_proteins) := lapply(
      .SD,
      function(x) scales::oob_squish((x - mean(x)) / sd(x),
        range = c(
          -1.5,
          1.5
        )
      )
    ),
    .SDcols = panel_proteins
  ]

  meta_phenograph_z <- Rphenographiterator(meta_data_in_z[, ..corephenotypingmarkers], n)

  # Phenograph all the ROI cluster medians
  meta_data_in[
    ,
    core_phenograph := factor(
      paste0(
        "core_",
        meta_phenograph$membership
      ),
      levels = gtools::mixedsort(unique(paste0(
        "core_",
        meta_phenograph$membership
      )))
    )
  ]

  meta_data_in[, meta_core_N := meta_data_counts[, N]]

  meta_data_in[, meta_core_entropy := Entropycalc(meta_core_N), by = phenographlevel]

  meta_data_in[, core_N := sum(meta_core_N), by = c(phenographlevel, "core_phenograph")]

  meta_data_in[, core_entropy := Entropycalc(core_N[!duplicated(core_phenograph)]), by = phenographlevel]

  meta_data_in[,
    cluster_entropy := Entropycalc(core_N[!duplicated(get(phenographlevel))]),
    by = "core_phenograph"
  ]

  core_meta_umap <- umap(meta_data_in[, ..corephenotypingmarkers])

  meta_data_in[
    ,
    c(
      "core_umap_x",
      "core_umap_y"
    ) := split(
      core_meta_umap,
      rep(1:ncol(core_meta_umap),
        each = nrow(core_meta_umap)
      )
    )
  ]

  assign(paste0("k", k, "n", n, "meta_data_in"), meta_data_in)

  meta_data_in_z[
    ,
    core_phenograph := factor(
      paste0(
        "core_",
        meta_phenograph_z$membership
      ),
      levels = gtools::mixedsort(unique(paste0(
        "core_",
        meta_phenograph_z$membership
      )))
    )
  ]

  meta_data_in_z[, meta_core_N := meta_data_counts[, N]]

  meta_data_in_z[, meta_core_entropy := Entropycalc(meta_core_N), by = phenographlevel]

  meta_data_in_z[, core_N := sum(meta_core_N), by = c(phenographlevel, "core_phenograph")]

  meta_data_in_z[, core_entropy := Entropycalc(core_N[!duplicated(core_phenograph)]), by = phenographlevel]

  meta_data_in_z[,
    cluster_entropy := Entropycalc(core_N[!duplicated(get(phenographlevel))]),
    by = "core_phenograph"
  ]

  core_meta_umap_z <- umap(meta_data_in_z[, ..corephenotypingmarkers])

  meta_data_in_z[
    ,
    c(
      "core_umap_x",
      "core_umap_y"
    ) := split(
      core_meta_umap_z,
      rep(1:ncol(core_meta_umap_z),
        each = nrow(core_meta_umap_z)
      )
    )
  ]

  assign(paste0("k", k, "n", n, "meta_data_in_z"), meta_data_in_z)

  # Blend ROI cluster medians with full data
  # data_in <- merge(data_in, meta_data_in[, list(get(phenographlevel), core_phenograph, meta_core_phenograph,
  #                                                       meta_core_N, core_entropy, meta_core_entropy)],
  #                  by = c(phenographlevel, "meta_core_phenograph"), sort=F)
  # }

  data_in <- merge(data_in, meta_data_in[, list(ROI, core_phenograph, meta_core_phenograph)],
    by = c(phenographlevel, "meta_core_phenograph"), sort = F
  )
}

heatmapwrap(data_in,
  manualphenotypingmarkers,
  "core_phenograph",
  display_numbers = T,
  cluster_rows = F,
  rankby = "percentage"
)

exportlist <- c(exportlist, "meta_data_in")
```

```{r Heatmaps}
# Generate heatmaps for each cluster

for (type in unique(data_in$supervised_core_phenograph)) {
  print(type)
  heatmap_data <- data_in[supervised_core_phenograph == type,
    lapply(
      .SD,
      function(x) median(x,
        na.rm = T
      )
    ),
    by = "subset_phenograph",
    .SDcols = manualphenotypingmarkers
  ]
  heatmap_counts <- data_in[supervised_core_phenograph == type, .N, by = "subset_phenograph"]
  heatmap_data <- merge(heatmap_data, heatmap_counts, by = "subset_phenograph")
  heatmap_data[, percentage := N / sum(N)]
  heatmap_data[
    ,
    percentageoutput := paste0(
      paste(get("subset_phenograph"),
        format(100 * percentage,
          digits = 2
        ),
        sep = ":"

      "%"
    )
  ]
  subset_phenographs <- heatmap_data$subset_phenograph
  entropies <- data_in[subset_phenograph %in% subset_phenographs,
    .N,
    by = c(
      "subset_phenograph",
      "ROI"
    )
  ][,
    .(entropy = Entropycalc(N)),
    by = subset_phenograph
  ]$entropy
  heatmap_data[, entropy := entropies / max(entropies)]
  OTentropies <- data_in[subset_phenograph %in% subset_phenographs,
    .N,
    by = c(
      "subset_phenograph",
      "OT"
    )
  ][,
    .(OTentropy = Entropycalc(N)),
    by = subset_phenograph
  ]$OTentropy
  heatmap_data[, OTentropy := OTentropies / max(OTentropies)]
  displaymarkers <- c(manualphenotypingmarkers, "entropy", "OTentropy")

  pal <- colorRampPalette(c(
    "#4575B4",
    "#74ADD1",
    "#ABD9E9",
    "#E0F3F8",
    "#FFFFBF",
    "#FEE090",
    "#FDAE61",
    "#F46D43",
    "#D73027"
  ))

  display_values <- melt(heatmap_data[, ..displaymarkers], variable.name = "marker")

  p <- plot_ly(
    x = displaymarkers,
    y = heatmap_data[, percentageoutput],
    z = as.matrix(heatmap_data[, ..displaymarkers]),
    type = "heatmap",
    colors = pal(10)
  ) %>%
    layout(title = type) %>%
    style(xgap = 0.5, ygap = 0.5) %>%
    add_annotations(
      x = display_values$marker,
      y = heatmap_data[
        ,
        percentageoutput
      ],
      text = round(display_values$value,
        digits = 2
      ),
      showarrow = F,
      font = list(color = 'black')
    )
  assign(paste0(type, "_heatmap"), p)
  print(p)
}
```

```{r Cluster Reassignment}
data_in[, corrected_core_phenograph := supervised_core_phenograph]

for (i in 1:ncol(supervisedclusters)) {
  # Identify the particular types that are incorrect
  typestoscan <- supervisedclusters[[2, i]]
  subclusterstoscan <- supervisedclusters[[3, i]]
  # Find subcluster names of incorrect clusters
  targets <- vector("character")
  for (j in 1:length(typestoscan))
  {
    targets <- c(targets, paste0("subset_", typestoscan[j], "_", subclusterstoscan[[j]]))
  }
  # Relabel the incorrect clusters as corrected_core_phenograph
  data_in[subset_phenograph %in% targets, corrected_core_phenograph := supervisedclusters[[1, i]]]
}
```

```{r Unknown Cell Cleanup}
# All ambiguous clusters that weren't pure get moved to the unknown clusters
data_in[corrected_core_phenograph %like% "_", corrected_core_phenograph := "Unknown"]

# Recluster all the ambiguous cells
phenographcleanup <- Rphenographiterator(
  data_in[
    corrected_core_phenograph == "Unknown",
    ..corephenotypingmarkers
  ],
  15
)

data_in[corrected_core_phenograph == "Unknown", unknowncleanup := phenographcleanup$membership]

# For all the unknown types, redo the phenotyping clusters to obtain mixed types
unknowntypes <- sort(unique(data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)]$unknowncleanup))
Runknownphenos <- vector("list", length(unknowntypes))
# unknowntypeiterator <- isplit(data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)], data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)]$unknowncleanup)
c1 <- makeCluster(cores)
registerDoParallel(c1)
Runknownphenos <- foreach(
  k = isplitDT(
    data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)],
    "unknowncleanup",
    unique(data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)]$unknowncleanup)
  ),
  .packages = c(
    "Rcpp",
    "Rphenograph",
    "data.table"
  ),
  .export = c("corephenotypingmarkers")
) %dopar% {
  if (nrow(k$value) < 15) {
    list(k$key[[1]], paste0("unknown_", k$key[[1]], "_1"))
  } else {
    list(
      k$key[[1]],
      paste0(
        "unknown_",
        k$key[[1]],
        "_",
        Rphenographiterator(
          k$value[
            ,
            ..corephenotypingmarkers
          ],
          15
        )$membership
      )
    )
  }
}
stopCluster(c1)
print("unknowncleanupdone")
print(Sys.time())
# For all the mixed cells, re-cluster them within the major groups
for (type in 1:length(unknowntypes)) {
  data_in[
    unknowncleanup == Runknownphenos[[type]][[1]],
    "unknown_sub_phenograph" := Runknownphenos[[type]][[2]]
  ]
}

heatmapwrap(data_in[!is.na(unknowncleanup)],
  manualphenotypingmarkers,
  "unknowncleanup",
  display_numbers = T,
  cluster_rows = F,
  rankby = "percentage"
)
```

```{r vascularization model convex}
polyAreaList <- list()

for (ROIImage in unique(data_in$ROI)) {
  print(ROIImage)

  # Extract ROI data
  ROIsubset <- data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", ..PointDatacols]

  if (nrow(ROIsubset) > 15) {
    # For each cell type i
    X <- ppp(
      x = ROIsubset[, jm],
      y = ROIsubset[, im],
      window = owin(
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(jm)],
          ROIsubset[, max(jm)]
        ),
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(im)],
          ROIsubset[, max(im)]
        )
      ),
      # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
      unitname = "micrometer"
    )

    Xconnect <- connected(X, 20)

    TLSthresholds <- names(table(Xconnect$marks)[table(Xconnect$marks) > 10])

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", TLScluster := as.character(Xconnect$marks)]
    # convex hull computation
    if (length(TLSthresholds)) {
      # areas for this ROI
      roiAreas <- lapply(TLSthresholds, function(cl) {
        pts <- X[Xconnect$marks == cl]
        # need ≥3 points for a polygon
        if (pts$n >= 3) {
          hull <- convexhull(pts)
          areaHull <- area.owin(hull) # μm²

          # plot(hull, add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 2)
        } else {
          areaHull <- NA_real_
        }
        data.table(
          ROI = ROIImage,
          TLScluster = as.character(cl),
          TLSarea = areaHull
        )
      })
      polyAreaList[[ROIImage]] <- rbindlist(roiAreas)
    }
    # data_in[, TLSclusterviable := NULL]

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo" & TLScluster %in% TLSthresholds, TLSclusterviable := T]
  }
}

TLSpolyAreas <- rbindlist(polyAreaList, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
data_in <- TLSpolyAreas[data_in, on = .(ROI, TLScluster)]
```

```{r vasculariztion model concave}
endo_concavity <- getOption("endo.concavity", 2)
extract_concave_coords <- function(hull) {
  if (is.list(hull) && !is.null(hull$polygon)) {
    hull <- hull$polygon
  }
  hull <- as.matrix(hull)
  if (!is.matrix(hull) || ncol(hull) < 2) {
    stop("need at least two columns of coordinates")
  }
  if (nrow(hull) >= 3) {
    x <- hull[, 1]
    y <- hull[, 2]
    x_next <- c(x[-1], x[1])
    y_next <- c(y[-1], y[1])
    signed_area <- sum(x * y_next - x_next * y) / 2
    if (!is.na(signed_area) && signed_area < 0) {
      hull <- hull[rev(seq_len(nrow(hull))), , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  hull
}

polyAreaList <- list()

for (ROIImage in unique(data_in$ROI)) {
  print(ROIImage)

  # Extract ROI data
  ROIsubset <- data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", ..PointDatacols]

  if (nrow(ROIsubset) > 15) {
    # For each cell type i
    X <- ppp(
      x = ROIsubset[, im],
      y = ROIsubset[, jm],
      window = owin(
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(im)],
          ROIsubset[, max(im)]
        ),
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(jm)],
          ROIsubset[, max(jm)]
        )
      ),
      # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
      unitname = "micrometer"
    )

    Xconnect <- connected(X, 20)

    Endothresholds <- names(table(Xconnect$marks)[table(Xconnect$marks) > 10])

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", Endocluster := as.character(Xconnect$marks)]
    # convex hull computation
    if (length(Endothresholds)) {
      # areas for this ROI
      roiAreas <- lapply(Endothresholds, function(cl) {
        pts <- X[Xconnect$marks == cl]
        # need ≥3 points for a polygon
        coords <- cbind(pts$x, pts$y)
        uniqueCoords <- unique(coords)
        # need ≥3 unique points for a polygon
        if (nrow(uniqueCoords) >= 3) {
          hullCoords <- extract_concave_coords(
            concaveman::concaveman(uniqueCoords, concavity = endo_concavity)
          )
          hullWindow <- owin(poly = list(
            x = hullCoords[, 1],
            y = hullCoords[, 2]
          ))
          areaHull <- area.owin(hullWindow) # μm²
        } else {
          areaHull <- NA_real_
        }
        data.table(
          ROI = ROIImage,
          Endocluster = as.character(cl),
          Endoarea = areaHull
        )
      })
      polyAreaList[[ROIImage]] <- rbindlist(roiAreas)
    }
    # data_in[, Endoclusterviable := NULL]

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo" & Endocluster %in% Endothresholds, Endoclusterviable := T]
  }
}

EndopolyAreas <- rbindlist(polyAreaList, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
data_in <- EndopolyAreas[data_in, on = .(ROI, Endocluster)]
```

```{r endothelial area percentage of each ROI}
endo_concavity <- getOption("endo.concavity", 2)
extract_concave_coords <- function(hull) {
  if (is.list(hull) && !is.null(hull$polygon)) {
    hull <- hull$polygon
  }
  hull <- as.matrix(hull)
  if (!is.matrix(hull) || ncol(hull) < 2) {
    stop("Unexpected concaveman output: need at least two columns of coordinates")
  }
  if (nrow(hull) >= 3) {
    x <- hull[, 1]
    y <- hull[, 2]
    x_next <- c(x[-1], x[1])
    y_next <- c(y[-1], y[1])
    signed_area <- sum(x * y_next - x_next * y) / 2
    if (!is.na(signed_area) && signed_area < 0) {
      hull <- hull[rev(seq_len(nrow(hull))), , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  hull
}

polyAreaList <- list()
roiAreaList <- list()

for (ROIImage in unique(data_in$ROI)) {
  print(ROIImage)

  # Extract ROI data
  ROIsubset <- data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", ..PointDatacols]

  # Concave hull for full ROI extent
  roiCoords <- unique(data_in[ROI == ROIImage, .(im, jm)])

  if (nrow(roiCoords) >= 3) {
    roiHullCoords <- extract_concave_coords(
      concaveman::concaveman(as.matrix(roiCoords), concavity = endo_concavity)
    )
    roiHullWindow <- owin(poly = list(
      x = roiHullCoords[, 1],
      y = roiHullCoords[, 2]
    ))
    roiAreaValue <- area.owin(roiHullWindow)
  } else {
    roiAreaValue <- NA_real_
  }
  roiAreaList[[ROIImage]] <- data.table(
    ROI = ROIImage,
    ROIarea = roiAreaValue
  )

  if (nrow(ROIsubset) > 15) {
    # For each cell type i
    X <- ppp(
      x = ROIsubset[, im],
      y = ROIsubset[, jm],
      window = owin(
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(im)],
          ROIsubset[, max(im)]
        ),
        c(
          ROIsubset[, min(jm)],
          ROIsubset[, max(jm)]
        )
      ),
      # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
      unitname = "micrometer"
    )
    # finds its connected components by linking points that lie within 20 µm of each other.
    Xconnect <- connected(X, 20)

    Endothresholds <- names(table(Xconnect$marks)[table(Xconnect$marks) > 10])

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo", Endocluster := as.character(Xconnect$marks)]
    # convex hull computation
    if (length(Endothresholds)) {
      # areas for this ROI
      roiAreas <- lapply(Endothresholds, function(cl) {
        pts <- X[Xconnect$marks == cl]
        coords <- cbind(pts$x, pts$y)
        uniqueCoords <- unique(coords)
        # need ≥3 unique points for a polygon
        if (nrow(uniqueCoords) >= 3) {
          hullCoords <- extract_concave_coords(
            concaveman::concaveman(uniqueCoords, concavity = endo_concavity)
          )
          #                           closedHull[-1, 1] * closedHull[-nrow(closedHull), 2])
          # if (signedArea < 0) {
          #   hull <- hull[nrow(hull):1, , drop = FALSE]
          # }
          hullWindow <- owin(poly = list(
            x = hullCoords[, 1],
            y = hullCoords[, 2]
          ))
          areaHull <- area.owin(hullWindow) # μm²
        } else {
          areaHull <- NA_real_
        }
        data.table(
          ROI = ROIImage,
          Endocluster = as.character(cl),
          Endoarea = areaHull
        )
      })
      polyAreaList[[ROIImage]] <- rbindlist(roiAreas)
    }
    # data_in[, Endoclusterviable := NULL]

    data_in[ROI == ROIImage & Phenotype == "Endo" & Endocluster %in% Endothresholds, Endoclusterviable := T]
  }
}

EndopolyAreas <- rbindlist(polyAreaList, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
```

```{r, label="Epithelial & Tumor cell correction, density based"}
data_in[, Epithelial_tumor_sub :=
  fifelse(Phenotype %chin% c("Epithelial", "Cancer"), as.character(Phenotype), "Other")]

k <- 5L

data_in[, nn5 := vector("list", .N)]

for (r in unique(data_in$ROI)) {
  dt <- data_in[ROI == r]
  xy <- as.matrix(dt[, .(im, jm)])
  ci <- dt[["ci"]]
  nn <- RANN::nn2(xy, k = k + 1L)
  idx <- nn$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE] # .N x 5\
  nbr_vec <- ci[as.vector(idx)]
  nbr_mat <- matrix(nbr_vec, nrow = nrow(idx), ncol = ncol(idx))

  nn5_list <- vector("list", nrow(nbr_mat))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(nbr_mat))) {
    nn5_list[[i]] <- nbr_mat[i, ]
  }

  data_in[ROI == r, nn5 := nn5_list]
}
```

```{r vasclar model convex plots}
out_dir <- VASCULAR_DIR
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ROIlist <- unique(data_in$ROI)

for (r in ROIlist) {
  dt_roi <- data_in[ROI == r]
  x_rng <- range(dt_roi$im, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(dt_roi$jm, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (nrow(dt_roi) == 0) next

  ## -------------------- 1) Base R: Endo + TLSclusterviable, colored by TLScluster + convex hulls
  cells <- dt_roi[Phenotype == "Endo" & TLSclusterviable == TRUE, .(jm, im, TLScluster)]

  f1 <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s__1_endoviable_clusters.png", r))
  png(f1, width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)
  if (nrow(cells) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = sprintf("ROI: %s\n(no Endo + viable TLS cells)", r))
  } else {
    cols <- rainbow(length(unique(cells$TLScluster)))
    cluster_col <- cols[as.integer(factor(cells$TLScluster))]

    plot(
      cells$jm, cells$im,
      xlim = x_rng, ylim = y_rng,
      pch = 16, col = cluster_col,
      asp = 1,
      xlab = "µm (x)", ylab = "µm (y)",
      main = paste("ROI:", r, "- Endo (TLS viable) by cluster")
    )

    # one convex hull per cluster (need ≥3 points)
    for (cl in sort(unique(cells$TLScluster))) {
      pts <- cells[TLScluster == cl, .(jm, im)]
      if (nrow(pts) >= 3) {
        hull <- chull(pts$jm, pts$im)
        polygon(pts$jm[hull], pts$im[hull], border = "red", lwd = 2)
      }
    }
    legend("topright",
      legend = levels(factor(cells$TLScluster)),
      fill = cols, title = "TLScluster", cex = 0.8, bty = "n"
    )
  }
  dev.off()

  ## -------------------- 2) ggplot: all cells, colored by TLSclusterviable
  p2 <- ggplot(dt_roi, aes(im, jm, colour = TLSclusterviable)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_rng, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_rng, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = paste("ROI:", r, "- TLS viable (all cells)"),
      x = "µm (y / im)", y = "µm (x / jm)", colour = "TLS viable"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s__2_tls_viable.png", r)),
    plot = p2, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )

  ## -------------------- 3) ggplot: all cells, Endo highlighted with a boolean color map
  # This directly answers your question: colour = Phenotype == "Endo"
  p3 <- ggplot(dt_roi, aes(im, jm, colour = Phenotype == "Endo")) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = x_rng, ylim = y_rng, expand = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      # tweak colours if you like
      values = c(`TRUE` = "#2C7FB8", `FALSE` = "grey75"),
      labels = c(`TRUE` = "Endo", `FALSE` = "Other"),
      name = "Phenotype"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("ROI:", r, "- Endothelial cells highlighted"),
      x = "µm (y / im)", y = "µm (x / jm)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s__3_endo_highlight.png", r)),
    plot = p3, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r vascular model concave plots}
out_dir <- VASCULAR_DIR
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ROIlist <- unique(data_in$ROI)

for (r in ROIlist) {
  dt_roi <- data_in[ROI == r]
  x_rng <- range(dt_roi$im, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(dt_roi$jm, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (nrow(dt_roi) == 0) next

  ## -------------------- 1) Base R: Endo + Endoclusterviable, colored by Endocluster + convex hulls
  cells <- dt_roi[Phenotype == "Endo" & Endoclusterviable == TRUE, .(jm, im, Endocluster)]

  f1 <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s__1_endoviable_clusters.png", r))
  png(f1, width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)
  if (nrow(cells) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = sprintf("ROI: %s\n(no Endo + viable Endo cells)", r))
  } else {
    cols <- rainbow(length(unique(cells$Endocluster)))
    cluster_col <- cols[as.integer(factor(cells$Endocluster))]

    plot(
      cells$jm, cells$im,
      xlim = x_rng, ylim = y_rng,
      pch = 16, col = cluster_col,
      asp = 1,
      xlab = "µm (x)", ylab = "µm (y)",
      main = paste("ROI:", r, "- Endo (Endo viable) by cluster")
    )

    # one concave hull per cluster (need ≥3 points)
    for (cl in sort(unique(cells$Endocluster))) {
      pts <- unique(cells[Endocluster == cl, .(jm, im)])
      if (nrow(pts) >= 3) {
        hull <- extract_concave_coords(
          concaveman::concaveman(as.matrix(pts), concavity = endo_concavity)
        )
        polygon(hull[, 1], hull[, 2], border = "red", lwd = 2)
      }
    }
    legend("topright",
```

```{r vascular summarize plot}
  ROIarea               = unique(ROIarea)[1],
  ROI_Endoarea_convex   = unique(ROI_Endoarea_convex)[1],
  ROI_Endoarea_concave  = unique(ROI_Endoarea_concave)[1]
), by = .(ROI, OT)]

roi <- roi[OT != "Control_C"]

dt_long <- melt(
  roi,
  id.vars       = c("OT", "ROI", "ROIarea"),
  measure.vars  = c("ROI_Endoarea_convex", "ROI_Endoarea_concave"),
  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name    = "endo_area"
)[is.finite(endo_area) & is.finite(ROIarea) & ROIarea > 0]

dt_long[, pct := pmin(pmax(endo_area / ROIarea, 0), 1)]

sumdt <- dt_long[, .(
  n    = .N,
  mean = mean(pct),
  sd   = sd(pct)
), by = .(OT, metric)][, se := fifelse(n > 1, sd / sqrt(n), NA_real_)]

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)

p <- ggplot(sumdt, aes(x = OT, y = mean, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    position = pd, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 0.07), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = tissue_order, labels = tissue_ordermap) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue type (OT)", y = "Endothelial area (% of ROI)",
    fill = "Metric",
    title = "Endothelial percentage by tissue type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r, label="cell cell composition by ROI& patient splited by SI and P, sorted by tissue"}
cellcount_by_case <- datan[
  , .(N = .N),
  by = .(ROI, Phenotype_refined, case, origin)
]

cellcount_by_case <- merge(
  cellcount_by_case, metadata[, .(ROI, tissue)],
  by = "ROI", all.x = TRUE
)

setDT(TMAs_clinical)
cellcount_by_case <- merge(
  cellcount_by_case, TMAs_clinical[, .(case, OS)],
  by = "case", all.x = TRUE
)

cellcount_by_case <- cellcount_by_case[origin != "Control"]

# ── FIX 1: Case factor — origin group order, then OS descending within group ──
case_meta <- cellcount_by_case[
  , .(
    OS = unique(OS)[1],
    origin = unique(origin)[1]
  ), # one origin per case
  by = case
]
group_order <- c("Ileum", "Pancreas") # ← adjust to your exact origin strings

case_levs <- case_meta[
  order(factor(origin, levels = group_order), -OS), # group first, then OS desc
  case
]
cellcount_by_case[, case := factor(case, levels = case_levs)]

# ── FIX 2: ROI order — cancer % descending, AFTER case levels are set ─────────
# Check: unique(cellcount_by_case$Phenotype_refined) to confirm the cancer label
cancer_pct <- cellcount_by_case[
  , .(
    cancer_N = sum(N[Phenotype_refined == "Cancer"]), # ← verify this label
    total_N  = sum(N)
  ),
  by = .(case, ROI, origin, tissue)
][, cancer_pct := fifelse(total_N == 0, 0, cancer_N / total_N)]

roi_order_case <- cancer_pct[
  order(case, -cancer_pct) # case respects the factor levels above
][
  , ROIplot := factor(ROI, levels = unique(ROI)),
  by = case
]

cellcount_by_case <- merge(
  cellcount_by_case,
  roi_order_case[, .(case, ROI, ROIplot)],
  by = c("case", "ROI"), all.x = TRUE
)

cellcount_by_case[, Phenotype_refined := factor(Phenotype_refined, levels = celltypeorder)]

# ── Strips & plots (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
os_strip <- ggplot(
  cellcount_by_case,
  aes(ROIplot, 1, fill = OS)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(case), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "green", name = "OS\n(months)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"), strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right"
  )

origin_strip <- ggplot(
  cellcount_by_case,
  aes(ROIplot, 1, fill = origin)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(case), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Origin", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"), strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right"
  )

tissue_strip <- ggplot(
  cellcount_by_case,
  aes(ROIplot, 1, fill = tissue)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(case), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", name = "Tissue", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"), strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right"
  )

cell_plot <- ggplot(
  cellcount_by_case,
  aes(x = ROIplot, y = N, fill = Phenotype_refined)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_fill()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltypecolor, breaks = celltypeorder) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(case), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "x") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + # FIX: was scale_y_discrete
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x       = unit(0, "lines"),
    strip.placement       = "outside",
    strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(0, "cm"),
    axis.text.x           = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x          = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x          = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Case  (← Ileum | Pancreas →, ranked by OS)", y = "Composition", fill = "Cell Type")

final_plot <- (
  origin_strip /
    os_strip /
    tissue_strip /
    cell_plot
) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 4), guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.justification = "top", legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt")
  )

print(final_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "cell composition summary_SI_P_Split_withcase.tiff"),
  plot = final_plot, width = 20, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

)
```

```{r map back cells}
  )
```

```{r Spatial Analysis}
"070622BF_NETS_IowaTMA4_046"
print("spatial analysis")

# generate the _pos columns in data
for (type in 1:length(correctedcelltypes)) {
  datan[, paste0(correctedcelltypes[type], "_pos") := 0]
  datan[Phenotype_refined == correctedcelltypes[type], paste0(correctedcelltypes[type], "_pos") := 1]
}
# All core clustering distances
cap <- 75

# Enter target cells (major corrected cell types plus additional _pos markers)
# targetpositives <- c(correctedcelltypes, newcellpos)
# Carry relevant data forward
# setnames(data_in, "centroid-0", "jm")
# setnames(data_in, "centroid-1", "im")
# setnames(data_in, "Object", "ci")

ROIsourcedata <- copy(datan[
  ,
  ..PointDatacols
]) # .. let datatable pull the variables from global env, instead looking for a col names "PointDatacols" in datan
NNtarget <- 5
count <- 0
ROIs <- unique(datan$ROI)
for (ROIImage in ROIs)
{
  count <- progresstrack(ROIImage, ROIs, count)
  # Extract ROI data
  ROIsubset <- ROIsourcedata[ROI == ROIImage]

  # Make dummy cells
  ROIdummy <- copy(ROIsubset[1:(NNtarget + 1)])
  ROIdummy[, ci := 1000000:(1000000 + NNtarget)]
  ROIdummy[, which(colnames(ROIdummy) %like% "_pos") := 1]
  ROIdummy[, which(colnames(ROIdummy) %in% c("im", "jm")) := 1000000:(1000000 + NNtarget)]

  ROIsubset <- rbind(ROIsubset, ROIdummy)

  # For each cell type i
  X <- ppp(
    x = ROIsubset[, jm],
    y = ROIsubset[, im],
    window = owin(
      c(
        ROIsubset[, min(jm)],
        ROIsubset[, max(jm)]
      ),
      c(
        ROIsubset[, min(im)],
        ROIsubset[, max(im)]
      )
    ),
    # marks = ROIsubset[,..PointDatalocation],
    unitname = "micrometer"
  )
  # Prepare dataset for cell subset

  NNsubi <- ROIsubset[, ..PointDatalocation]

  Xcentroids <- vector("list", length(targetpositives))
  Ycentroids <- vector("list", length(targetpositives))
  NNcentroiddistances <- vector("list", length(targetpositives))

  # Compare to each cell type j
  for (j in targetpositives) {
    # Generate points
    index_j <- ROIsubset[[paste0(j, "_pos")]] == 1

    # Y <- ppp(x = ROIsubset[index_j,jm],
    #          y = ROIsubset[index_j,im],
    #          window = owin(c(ROIsubset[,min(jm)],
    #                          ROIsubset[,max(jm)]),
    #                        c(ROIsubset[,min(im)],
    #                          ROIsubset[,max(im)])),
    #          # marks = ROIsubset[index_j,..PointDatalocation],
    #          unitname = "micrometer")
    Y <- X[which(index_j == T)]

    # Find spatial nearest neighbors of i in j
    NNdataj <- as.data.table(nncross(X, Y,
      k = 1:NNtarget,
      iX = as.integer(ROIsubset$ci),
      iY = as.integer(ROIsubset[index_j]$ci),
      # is.sorted.X=T, is.sorted.Y=T, sortby="y"
    ))

    # Find cells by object number instead of index
    NNdataj[,
      which(names(NNdataj) %like% "which") := lapply(
        .SD,
        function(x) ROIsubset[index_j][
          x,
          ci
        ]
      ),
      .SDcols = names(NNdataj) %like% "which"
    ]

    # Name the columns for cell type j
    colnames(NNdataj) <- paste0(j, ".", colnames(NNdataj))

    # Store data
    NNsubi <- cbind(NNsubi, NNdataj)

    coltargets <- names(NNdataj)[names(NNdataj) %like% ".which"]
    NNminiX <- NNdataj[, ..coltargets]
    NNminiY <- NNdataj[, ..coltargets]
    NNminiX[, (coltargets) := lapply(.SD, function(x) ROIsubset[match(x, ci), jm]), .SDcols = coltargets]
    NNminiY[, (coltargets) := lapply(.SD, function(x) ROIsubset[match(x, ci), im]), .SDcols = coltargets]

    # Calculate X,Y centroid for each cell type
    Xcentroids[[which(targetpositives == j)]] <- NNminiX[, rowMeans(NNminiX, na.rm = T)]

    Ycentroids[[which(targetpositives == j)]] <- NNminiY[, rowMeans(NNminiY, na.rm = T)]

    # Calculate distance from each cell to each centroid for each cell type
    NNcentroiddistances[[which(targetpositives == j)]] <- sqrt((Xcentroids[[which(targetpositives == j)]] - NNsubi$jm)^2 + (Ycentroids[[which(targetpositives == j)]] - NNsubi$im)^2)
  }
  # Perform centroid calculations
  # NNX <- copy(NNsubi)
  # NNY <- copy(NNsubi)

  # # For every cell type
  # for (cluster in 1:length(targetpositives))
  # {
  #   # Identify the columns containing spatial data for type
  #   coltargets <- names(NNsubi)[names(NNsubi) %like% paste0("^",targetpositives[cluster],".which")]
  #   NNminiX <- NNsubi[,..coltargets]
  #   NNminiY <- NNsubi[,..coltargets]
  #
  #   # For every kth nearest neighbor, calculate the X,Y coordinates
  #   # for (k in 1:NNtarget){
  #   # Xmeans <- ROIsubset[,jm, key=ci]
  #   # colnames(Xmeans)[1] <- coltargets[k]
  #   # Repla <- Xmeans[NNminiX[,..k], on= coltargets[k]][,2]
  #   # NNminiX[,coltargets[k] := Repla]
  #   # Replace ci with X/Y coordinates
  #   NNminiX[,(coltargets) := lapply(.SD, function(x) ROIsubset[match(x, ci),jm]), .SDcols=coltargets]
  #
  #   # Ymeans <- ROIsubset[,im, key=ci]
  #   # colnames(Ymeans)[1] <- coltargets[k]
  #   # Repla <- Ymeans[NNminiY[,..k], on= coltargets[k]][,2]
  #   # NNminiY[,coltargets[k] := Repla]
  #   NNminiY[,(coltargets) := lapply(.SD, function(x) ROIsubset[match(x, ci),im]), .SDcols=coltargets]
  #
  #   # }
  #   # Store XY data if necessary
  #   # NNX[,paste0(coltargets,"_jm") := NNminiX]
  #   # NNY[,paste0(coltargets,"_im") := NNminiY]
  #
  #   # Calculate X,Y centroid for each cell type
  #   Xcentroids[[cluster]] <- NNminiX[,rowMeans(NNminiX, na.rm=T)]
  #
  #   Ycentroids[[cluster]] <- NNminiY[,rowMeans(NNminiY, na.rm=T)]
  #
  #   # Calculate distance from each cell to each centroid for each cell type
  #   NNcentroiddistances[[cluster]] <- sqrt((Xcentroids[[cluster]]-NNsubi$jm)^2 + (Ycentroids[[cluster]]-NNsubi$im)^2)
  #
  #   # NNfail[[cluster]] <- apply(NNminiX,1,function(x) any(is.na(x)))
  #   # NN[,paste0(i,c("NNXcentroid","NNYcentroid")) := ROIsubset[ci %in% (names(NN) %like% paste0(i,".which")), .(meanx=mean(jm), meany=mean(im))], by = ci]
  #   #
  #   # ROIsubset[ROI_phenograph == i, c("selfnn5dist", "selfnn5sd") := .(rowMeans(NNself[,1:5]), apply(NNself[, 1:5], 1, sd))]
  # }

  # Store new distance data for centroids
  newnncentroidcols <- apply(
    expand.grid(
      c(
        "NN.centroid.X.",
        "NN.centroid.Y.",
        "NN.centroiddist."
      ),
      targetpositives
    ),
    1,
    paste,
    collapse = ""
  )

  idx <- order(c(seq_along(Xcentroids), seq_along(Ycentroids), seq_along(NNcentroiddistances)))

  NNsubi[, (newnncentroidcols) := (c(Xcentroids, Ycentroids, NNcentroiddistances))[idx]]

  # Substitute spatial calculations back in to ROI subset data
  spatialcolumns <- names(NNsubi)[(names(NNsubi) %like% "dist") | (names(NNsubi) %like% "NN")]
  spatialdata <- NNsubi[, ..spatialcolumns]
  spatialdata <- spatialdata[1:(nrow(spatialdata) - NNtarget - 1)]

  spatialdata <- censor(spatialdata, cap = cap) / cap

  for (target in targetpositives) {
    regexin <- paste0("^", target, "[.]")
    distancecols <- colnames(spatialdata)[grep(regexin, colnames(spatialdata))]

    spatialdata[, paste0(target, ".density") := (NNtarget - rowSums(.SD)) / NNtarget, .SDcols = distancecols]
  }

  rmcols <- c(
    grep("centroid\\.",
      colnames(spatialdata),
      value = T
    ),
    grep("\\.dist(?!.1)",
      colnames(spatialdata),
      value = T,
      perl = T
    )
  )

  spatialdata[, (rmcols) := NULL]

  datan[ROI == ROIImage, (colnames(spatialdata)) := spatialdata]
}
```

```{r Spatial Cluster}
  list(out$tot.withinss, out$betweenss)
```

```{r reproduce biomaker}
dens_cols <- c(
  "Cancer.density", "Fibro.density", "B.density", "Epithelial.density",
  "CD4.density", "Endo.density", "Myel.density", "CD8.density",
  "Mac.density", "LymphEC.density", "Treg.density"
)

dt <- copy(datan[, c("spatialcluster", dens_cols), with = FALSE])

dt <- dt[complete.cases(dt)]
dt[, spatialcluster := factor(spatialcluster)]

clusters <- levels(dt$spatialcluster)

tree_list <- lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
  # 1) response: cluster cl vs others
  y <- factor(dt$spatialcluster == cl,
    levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    labels = c("other", cl)
  )

  # 2) predictors: only densities
  x <- as.data.frame(dt[, ..dens_cols])

  # 3) combine into one data.frame
  df <- data.frame(y = y, x)

  rpart(
    y ~ .,
    data = df,
    method = "class",
    control = rpart.control(
      cp        = 0.01,
      minbucket = 200,
      xval      = 0
    )
  )
})
names(tree_list) <- clusters

rpart.plot(tree_list[[8]], type = 3, extra = 104, cex = 1, tweak = 0.7)
# spatial 5 CD4 < 0.37 & CD8 >= 0.35 & cancer < 0.42 & mac >= 0.26 $ epi >= 0.47
# cd4 >= 0.37 & epi > = 0.39 & CD8 >=0.17 & cancer < 0.52
# cd4 >= 0.37 & epi > = 0.39 & CD8 <0.17 & myel >= 0.055
```

```{r Survival prep}
spatialanalysissavelocation <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "spatial_analysis")
strip_glm_env <- function(glm_obj) {
  glm_obj$model <- NULL
  glm_obj$y <- NULL
  glm_obj$x <- NULL
  attr(glm_obj$terms, ".Environment") <- baseenv()
  if (!is.null(glm_obj$formula)) environment(glm_obj$formula) <- baseenv()
  return(glm_obj)
}
save(
  list = c(
    "meta",
    "statsmeta",
    "dat",

    "spatialanalysissavelocation",
```

```{r patient level survival2}
patientlevel_survival2_results <- list()

biomarkergroups <- list(
  # list(c(quote(1:nrow(metadata))),     "all",      "metadata", "case")
  # list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas")), "Pan_origin",  "data_in",  "case"),
```
