```{r patient level survival2}
  # list(c(quote(Cancer_pos == 1 &  (NN.centroiddist.CD8 < 0.5| NN.centroiddist.Mac < 0.5))),    "Immunerich_cancercentric",  "data_in",  "case"),
  # list(c(quote(Endoarea > 0)), "vascularized_area0", "data_in", "case"),
  # list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas")), "Pan_origin",  "Primarytumor",  "case"),
  # list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum")),    "SB_origin",  "Primarytumor",  "case")
  # list(c(quote((CD8_pos==1 | Mac_pos==1 | CD4_pos==1 | Myel_pos == 1| B_pos == 1 | Treg_pos ==1) &  NN.centroiddist.Cancer < 0.5)), "Immunerich_immunecentric",  "Primarytumor",  "case")
  # list(c(quote((CD8_pos==1 | Mac_pos==1 | CD4_pos==1 | Myel_pos == 1| B_pos == 1 | Treg_pos ==1) &  NN.centroiddist.Cancer < 0.5)), "Immunerich_immunecentric",  "data_in",  "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas")), "Pan_origin", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum")), "SB_origin", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas" & tissue == "L")), "P_Lmet", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum" & tissue == "L")), "SB_Lmet", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum" & tissue == "T")), "SB_T", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas" & tissue == "T")), "P_T", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum" & tissue == "LN")), "SB_LNmet", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas" & tissue == "LN")), "P_LNmet", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(tissue == "T")), "tumor", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(tissue == "L")), "Lmet", "datan", "case"),
  list(c(quote(tissue == "LN")), "LNmet", "datan", "case")
  # list(c(quote(tissue == "N")),        "Normal",   "datan",  "case")
  # list(c(quote(tissue == "O")),        "Omet",     "data_in",  "case")
  # list(c(quote(origin == "Pancreas")), "Pan_origin",  "N_removed",  "case"),
  # list(c(quote(origin == "Ileum")),    "SB_origin",  "N_removed",  "case")
)

for (condition in biomarkergroups) {
  survivalcondition <- condition[[2]]

  survivalvars <- c("sex", "origin", "tissue", "OS", "PFS", "status")

  glmvars <- c("sex", "origin", "tissue", "status")

  cellselectindex <- 1:nrow(datan)

  groupvariable <- condition[[4]]
  # length(unique(paste0(origin, get(groupvariable))))/length(unique(get(groupvariable)))
  if ("metadata" %in% condition[[3]]) {
    metaselectsubset <- metadata[eval(condition[[1]][[match("metadata", condition[[3]])]]), ROI]
    # condition[[1]][[1]], list(list("a","b","c"),list(1,2,3))
    cellselectindex <- intersect(cellselectindex, datan[ROI %in% metaselectsubset, which = T])
  }

  if ("Primarytumor" %in% condition[[3]]) {
    pt_cases <- Primarytumor[eval(condition[[1]][[match("Primarytumor", condition[[3]])]]), ROI]
    datselectindex <- datan[ROI %in% pt_cases, which = TRUE]
    cellselectindex <- intersect(cellselectindex, datselectindex)
  }
  #
  # if ("N_removed" %in% condition[[3]]) {
  # Nrm_cases <- N_removed[eval(condition[[1]][[match("N_removed", condition[[3]])]]), ROI]
  # datselectindex <- datan[ROI %in% Nrm_cases, which = TRUE]
  # cellselectindex <- intersect(cellselectindex, datselectindex)
  # }
  #
  if ("datan" %in% condition[[3]]) {
    datselectindex <- datan[eval(condition[[1]][[match("datan", condition[[3]])]]), which = T]
    cellselectindex <- intersect(cellselectindex, datselectindex)
  }

  subdatacols <- c(
    "ROI",
    "Object",
    "spatialcluster",
    "case",
    "Endoarea",
    "Endocluster",
    "patient_endoarea_concave",
    "ROI_Endoarea_concave",
    "patient_endoarea_convex",
    "EndothelialAreaPercent",
    "patient_endoarea_percent",
    "CD8.density",
    "CD4.density",
    "Mac.density",
    "M2mac.density",
    "Fibro.density",
    "Treg.density",
    "B.density",
    "Epithelial.density",
    "Cancer.density",
    "Endo.density", "IL6", "IL10", "PDL1", "TGFB", "Ki67"
  )
  subdata <- datan[cellselectindex, names(datan) %like% "pos" | names(datan) %in% subdatacols, with = F]
  interestedcell <- c("Fibro", "Mac", "CD4", "CD8", "Treg", "B", "Endo")

  # Compute mean density per cell type per ROI
  density_cols <- paste0(interestedcell, ".density") # e.g. "Fibro.density"
  mean_col_names <- paste0(interestedcell, "_meandensity")

  # Step 1: Filter to Cancer cells, compute mean density per ROI for each cell type
  cancer_means <- subdata[Cancer_pos == 1,
    lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = ROI,
    .SDcols = density_cols
  ]
  setnames(cancer_means, density_cols, mean_col_names)

  subdata <- cancer_means[subdata, on = "ROI"]
  subdata_archive <- if (!exists("subdata_archive")) list() else subdata_archive
  subdata_archive[[survivalcondition]] <- subdata
  # survivalvars <- survivalvars[!(metadata[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI), lapply(.SD, function(x) length(unique(paste0(x, get(groupvariable))))/length(unique(get(groupvariable)))), .SDcols=survivalvars]!=1) & !(metadata[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI), lapply(.SD, function(x) length(unique(x))==1), .SDcols = survivalvars])]
  # glmvars <- glmvars[!(metadata[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI), lapply(.SD, function(x) length(unique(paste0(x, get(groupvariable))))/length(unique(get(groupvariable)))), .SDcols=glmvars]!=1) & !(metadata[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI), lapply(.SD, function(x) length(unique(x))==1), .SDcols = glmvars])]

  survivaldat <- metadata[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI),
    lapply(.SD, function(x) unique(na.omit(x))[1]),
    .SDcols = c(union(survivalvars, glmvars)),
    by = c(groupvariable)
  ]
  ## bug, if using only origin as condition, subdata contains multiple tissue site, [1] only keep the first. Does not affect COX, but GLM is problmatic
  survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, subdata[, .(Cells = .N), by = groupvariable], by = groupvariable)

  # merge correlation results to survivaldat
  # ── Per-condition, per-patient correlation ─────────────────────────────────
  corr_condition_cols <- character(0)

  corr_cols_for_survival <- c(
    "CD8.density", "Mac.density", "CD4.density", "Fibro.density",
    "Treg.density",
    "B.density",
    "PDL1", "TGFB", "IL6", "IL10", "Ki67"
  )
  corr_targets <- c("PDL1", "TGFB", "IL6", "IL10", "Ki67")

  cancer_subdata <- subdata[Cancer_pos == 1]

  missing_corr_cols <- setdiff(corr_cols_for_survival, names(cancer_subdata))

  if (nrow(cancer_subdata) >= 3L && length(missing_corr_cols) == 0L) {
    correlation_condition <- tryCatch(
      correlate_dt2(
        cancer_subdata,
        cols       = corr_cols_for_survival,
        by         = groupvariable, # "case" → one correlation per patient
        method     = "spearman",
        mode       = "target",
        target     = corr_targets,
        slope_type = "ols",
        p_adjust   = "BH"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("Correlation failed for [", survivalcondition, "]: ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(correlation_condition) && nrow(correlation_condition) > 0L) {
      correlation_condition[, pair_id := paste(var_x, var_y, sep = "_")]
      correlation_condition[, corr_strata := fifelse(
        p_adj <= 0.05 & cor > 0, "pos_sig",
        fifelse(p_adj <= 0.05 & cor < 0, "neg_sig", "not_sig")
      )]

      dup_check <- correlation_condition[, .N, by = c(groupvariable, "pair_id")]
      if (any(dup_check$N > 1)) {
        stop("Duplicate groupvariable + pair_id combinations found in correlation_condition")
      }
      corr_wide <- dcast(
        correlation_condition,
        as.formula(paste(groupvariable, "~ pair_id")),
        value.var = "corr_strata"
      )

      survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, corr_wide, by = groupvariable, all.x = TRUE)
      corr_condition_cols <- setdiff(names(corr_wide), groupvariable)
    }
  } else {
    if (length(missing_corr_cols) > 0L)
      warning(
        "[", survivalcondition, "] Skipping correlation — missing columns: ",
        paste(missing_corr_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    else
      warning("[", survivalcondition, "] Skipping correlation — fewer than 3 cancer cells after filtering.")
  }

  if (length(corr_condition_cols)) {
    survivaldat[, (corr_condition_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      vals <- as.character(x)
      # vals[is.na(vals)] <- "not_sig"
      factor(vals, levels = c("neg_sig", "not_sig", "pos_sig"))
    }), .SDcols = corr_condition_cols]
  }

  cellsubtypes <- grep("_pos$", colnames(datan), value = T)
  cellsubtypes <- sub("_pos", "", cellsubtypes)

  for (i in cellsubtypes) {
    cell_counts <- subdata[get(paste0(i, "_pos")) == 1, .N, by = groupvariable]
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Cells") := 0L]
    survivaldat[cell_counts, on = groupvariable, (paste0(i, "_Cells")) := i.N]
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Percent") := get(paste0(i, "_Cells")) / get("Cells")]
  }

  for (i in unique(subdata$spatialcluster)) {
    cell_counts <- subdata[spatialcluster == i, .N, by = groupvariable]
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Cells") := 0L]
    survivaldat[cell_counts, on = groupvariable, (paste0(i, "_Cells")) := i.N]
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Percent") := get(paste0(i, "_Cells")) / get("Cells")]
  }

  # #reproduce spatial clusters
  # CD4 < 0.37 & CD8 >= 0.35 & cancer < 0.42 & mac >= 0.26 $ epi >= 0.47
  # cd4 >= 0.37 & epi > = 0.39 & CD8 >=0.17 & cancer < 0.52
  density_features <- c(
    "CD8.density",
    "CD4.density",
    "Mac.density",
    "Fibro.density",
    "Epithelial.density",
    "Cancer.density",
    "Endo.density"
  )
  if (all(density_features %in% names(subdata))) {
    # spatial5_counts <- subdata[
    #   (CD4.density <0.37 & CD8.density >=0.35 & Cancer.density <0.42 & Mac.density >=0.26 &  Epithelial.density >= 0.47) |
    #    (CD4.density >= 0.37 & Epithelial.density >= 0.49 & CD8.density >=0.17 & Cancer.density < 0.52 ),
    #   .N,
    #   by = groupvariable
    # ]
    # 0.3,0,3,0.55,0.1
    spatial7_counts <- subdata[
      Cancer.density > 0.45 & Fibro.density > 0.25 & (Mac.density + CD8.density > 0.45) & CD4.density < 0.1,
      .N,
      by = groupvariable
    ]
    # # #   spatial4_counts <- subdata[
    # # #       Mac.density > 0.5 &
    # # #       Fibro.density > 0.4 &
    # # #       Epithelial.density >0.5 &
    # # #       Cancer_pos == 1,
    # # #     .N,
    # # #     by = groupvariable
    # # #   ]
    spatial4_counts <- subdata[
      Cancer.density > 0.7 & Fibro.density > 0.6 & Endo.density > 0.5,
      .N,
      by = groupvariable
    ]
    survivaldat[, spatialbiomarker7_Cells := 0L]
    survivaldat[spatial7_counts, on = groupvariable, spatialbiomarker7_Cells := i.N]
    survivaldat[, spatialbiomarker7_Percent := spatialbiomarker7_Cells / Cells]

    survivaldat[, spatialbiomarker4_Cells := 0L]
    survivaldat[spatial4_counts, on = groupvariable, spatialbiomarker4_Cells := i.N]
    survivaldat[, spatialbiomarker4_Percent := spatialbiomarker4_Cells / Cells]
  }

  # survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat,
  #     subdata[, .(patient_endoarea_concave = patient_endoarea_concave[1L]),by = groupvariable],
  #     by= groupvariable, all.x=TRUE)
  survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat,
    subdata[, .(patient_endoarea_percent = patient_endoarea_percent[1L]), by = groupvariable],
    by = groupvariable, all.x = TRUE
  )

  # add mean density of interested cells around cancer cells to survivaldat
  meandensity_patient <- unique(subdata[, c("ROI", groupvariable, mean_col_names), with = FALSE])[
    , lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = groupvariable, .SDcols = mean_col_names
  ]
  survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, meandensity_patient, by = groupvariable, all.x = TRUE)

  # ── Cancer cell immunomodulatory expression ──────────────────────────────
  cancer_immuno_markers <- c("IL6", "IL10", "PDL1", "TGFB", "Ki67")
  cancer_immuno_col_names <- paste0("Cancer_", cancer_immuno_markers, "_mean")

  if (all(cancer_immuno_markers %in% names(subdata))) {
    # Step 1: ROI-level mean for cancer cells only
    cancer_immuno_roi <- subdata[
      Cancer_pos == 1,
      lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      by = c("ROI", groupvariable),
      .SDcols = cancer_immuno_markers
    ]
    setnames(cancer_immuno_roi, cancer_immuno_markers, cancer_immuno_col_names)

    # Step 2: aggregate ROI means to patient level
    cancer_immuno_patient <- cancer_immuno_roi[
      , lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      by = groupvariable,
      .SDcols = cancer_immuno_col_names
    ]

    survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, cancer_immuno_patient, by = groupvariable, all.x = TRUE)
  } else {
    cancer_immuno_col_names <- character(0) # graceful fallback
    warning("One or more of cytokines not found in subdata; skipping cancer immuno stratification.")
  }
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # area
  # tls_area_by_cluster <- subdata[
  #   !is.na(TLScluster) & TLScluster != 0 & !is.na(TLSarea),
  #   .(TLSarea_unique = max(TLSarea, na.rm = TRUE)),
  #   by = c(groupvariable, "ROI", "TLScluster")
  # ]
  #
  # # sum to patient
  # tls_total_by_patient <- tls_area_by_cluster[
  #   , .(TLS_TotalArea = sum(TLSarea_unique, na.rm = TRUE)),
  #   by = groupvariable
  # ]
  #
  # # attach to survivaldat
  # survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, tls_total_by_patient, by = groupvariable, all.x = TRUE)
  # survivaldat[is.na(TLS_TotalArea), TLS_TotalArea := 0]

  survivaldat[is.nan(survivaldat)] <- 0
  cellcols <- grep("Cells$", names(survivaldat), value = TRUE)
  percentcols <- grep("Percent$", names(survivaldat), value = TRUE)
  areacols <- "patient_endoarea_percent"

  survivaldat[, (cellcols) := NULL]
  if (length(percentcols)) survivaldat[, (percentcols) := round(.SD, 4), .SDcols = percentcols]

  # threshold BOTH Percent and Area features
  contvars <- c(percentcols, areacols, mean_col_names, cancer_immuno_col_names)
  for (i in contvars) {
    classif <- as.integer(survivaldat[[i]] > median(survivaldat[[i]], na.rm = TRUE))
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Median_Thres") := classif]
    classif <- as.integer(survivaldat[[i]] > mean(survivaldat[[i]], na.rm = TRUE))
    survivaldat[, paste0(i, "_Mean_Thres") := classif]
  }
  # survivaldat <- merge(survivaldat, statsmeta[ROI %in% unique(subdata$ROI), lapply(.SD, unique), .SDcols=c(setdiff(colnames(statsmeta),colnames(metadata))), by=ROI], by="ROI")

  # identicalcols <- unname(which(apply(survivaldat, 2, function(a) length(unique(a))==1)))
  # survivaldat[, (identicalcols) := NULL]

  # Clinical variables "Norelapsecase",
  conditions <- c(
    intersect(
      survivalvars,
      c(
        "EBV",
        "MHCI",
        "MHCII",
        "SEX",
        "STAGEGR",
        "PDL1CopyNum",
        "PDL1Amp",
        "EarlyRelapse",
        "LateRelapse",
        "Refractory"
      )
    ),
    grep("Thres",
      colnames(survivaldat),
      value = T
    )
  )
  conditions <- conditions[(survivaldat[,
    lapply(
      .SD,
      function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))) == 1
    ),
    .SDcols = conditions
  ] != 1)]
  conditions <- unique(c(conditions, corr_condition_cols))

  codes <- list(c("OS", "status"), c("PFS", "status"))

  codes <- codes[which(!sapply(codes, function(x) !(all(x %in% survivalvars))))]

  non_corr_conditions <- setdiff(conditions, corr_condition_cols)
  if (length(non_corr_conditions)) {
    survivaldat[, (non_corr_conditions) := lapply(.SD, function(x) factor(x)), .SDcols = non_corr_conditions]
  }

  # survivaldat[,(conditions) := lapply(.SD, function(x) factor(x)), .SDcols=conditions]

  # glmconditions <- union(setdiff(grep("Percent",colnames(survivaldat), value=T), grep("Thres", colnames(survivaldat), value=T)), grep("biomarker", colnames(survivaldat), value=T))
  glmconditions <- union(
    setdiff(
      grep("Percent",
        colnames(survivaldat),
        value = T
      ),
      grep("Thres",
        colnames(survivaldat),
        value = T
      )
    ),
    "patient_endoarea_percent"
  )
  # setdiff(x,y) find the elements which are in the first Object but not in the second Object.
  # union(x,y)takes two objects like Vectors, dataframes, etc. as arguments and results in a third object with the combination of the data of both the objects.
  glmconditions <- glmconditions[(survivaldat[,
    lapply(
      .SD,
      function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))) == 1
    ),
    .SDcols = glmconditions
  ] != 1)]

  coxresults <- data.table(
    index = 1:(length(conditions) * length(codes)),
    groups = vector("character", length(conditions) * length(codes)),
    conditions = vector("character", length(conditions) * length(codes)),
    codes = vector("character", length(conditions) * length(codes)),
    pvalues = vector("numeric", length(conditions) * length(codes))
  )
  glmresults <- data.table(
    index = 1:(length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars)),
    groups = vector("character", length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars)),
    conditions = vector("character", length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars)),
    codes = vector("character", length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars)),
    pvalues = vector("numeric", length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars)),
    coef = vector("numeric", length(glmconditions) * length(glmvars))
  )
  survformulas <- list()
  glmobjects <- list()

  # survivaldat[, status := rep(1,nrow(survivaldat))]

  counter <- 1
  for (i in conditions) {
    for (j in codes) {
      timevar <- j[1]
      statusvar <- j[2]
      coxresults[
        counter,
        c(
          "groups",
          "conditions",
          "codes",
          "pvalues"
        ) := data.table(
          survivalcondition,
          i,
          j[1],
          NA
        )
      ]
      if (!(all(is.na(survivaldat[!is.na(survivaldat[[i]])][[statusvar]])))) {
        survformula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", j[1], ", ", j[2], ") ~ ", i))
        fit10 <- survfit(survformula,
          data = survivaldat[,
            c(
              j[1],
              j[2],
              i,
              groupvariable
            ),
            with = F
          ],
          id = survivaldat[[groupvariable]]
        )
        fit10$call$formula <- survformula
        coxout <- coxph(survformula,
          data = survivaldat[,
            c(
              j[1],
              j[2],
              i
            ),
            with = F
          ],
          id = survivaldat[[groupvariable]]
        )
        coef_est <- summary(coxout)$coefficients[, "coef"]
        hr_est <- exp(coef_est)
        coxresults[counter, `:=`(
          coef = list(coef_est),
          HR = list(hr_est),
          ratio = max(fit10$n) / sum(fit10$n)
        )]
        if (!is.na(summary(coxout)$waldtest[3])) {
          coxresults[counter, c("pvalues") := list(summary(coxout)$waldtest[3])]
          attr(survformula, ".Environment") <- NULL
          survformulas[[counter]] <- survformula
          survP <- ggsurvplot(
            fit10, # survfit object with calculated statistics.
            data = survivaldat, # data used to fit survival curves.
            risk.table = TRUE, # show risk table.
            pval = TRUE, # show p-value of log-rank test.
            pval.size = 14,
            conf.int = FALSE, # show confidence intervals for
            # point estimates of survival curves.
            xlab = "Months", # customize X axis label.
            ylab = j,
            title = survivalcondition,
            break.time.by = 10, # break X axis in time intervals by 500.
            ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 25), # customize plot and risk table with a theme.
            risk.table.y.text.col = T, # colour risk table text annotations.
            risk.table.height = 0.25, # the height of the risk table
            risk.table.y.text = FALSE, # show bars instead of names in text annotations
            # in legend of risk table.
            risk.table.fontsize = 7,
            ncensor.plot = FALSE, # plot the number of censored subjects at time t
            ncensor.plot.height = 0.1,
            conf.int.style = "step", # customize style of confidence intervals
            # surv.median.line = "hv",  # add the median survival pointer.
            tables.theme = theme_cleantable(),
            palette = "nejm"
          )
          outfn <- sprintf(
            "%s_%s_%s.pdf",
            survivalcondition,
            gsub("\\W+", "", i),
            timevar
          )
          pdf(file.path(survPlocation, outfn),
            width = 10,
            height = 10
          )
          print(survP)
          dev.off()
        } else {
          coxresults[counter, c("pvalues") := list(NA)]
          survformulas[[counter]] <- NA
        }
      } else {
        coxresults[counter, c("pvalues") := list(NA)]
        survformulas[[counter]] <- NA
      }

      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }

  counter <- 1

  for (i in glmconditions) {
    for (j in glmvars) {
      glmresults[
        counter,
        c(
          "groups",
          "conditions",
          "codes",
          "pvalues",
          "coef"
        ) := data.table(
          survivalcondition,
          i,
          j[1],
          NA,
          NA
        )
      ]
      if (length(unique(survivaldat[[j]][!is.na(survivaldat[[i]])])) != 1) {
        glmdat <- survivaldat[, c(i, j, groupvariable), with = F]
        glmdat <- glmdat[apply(glmdat[, c(i), with = F], 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))]
        glmout <- glm.cluster(
          as.formula(paste0(
            "`",
            i,
            "` ~ `",
            j,
            "`"
          )),
          data = glmdat,
          cluster = glmdat[[groupvariable]]
        )
        if (!any(is.na(summary(glmout$glm_res)$coefficients[-1, 4]))) {
          glmresults[
            counter,
            c(
              "pvalues",
              "coef"
            ) := list(
              min(summary(glmout$glm_res)$coefficients[
                -1,
                4
              ]),
              summary(glmout$glm_res)$coefficients[
                2,
                1
              ]
            )
          ]
          if (any(summary(glmout$glm_res)$coefficients[-1, 4] < 0.05)) { # | counter %in% interestingsamples){
            glmout$glm_res <- strip_glm_env(glmout$glm_res)
            glmobjects[[counter]] <- glmout
            # p <- eval(parse(text=paste0("ggplot(survivaldat, aes(x=factor(",
            #                             j,"), y=",i,"))+geom_boxplot()+labs(x='",j,"', y='",i,"')")))
          } else {
            glmobjects[[counter]] <- NA
          }
        }
      } else {
        glmresults[counter, c("pvalues", "coef") := list(NA, NA)]
        glmobjects[[counter]] <- NA
      }

      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }

  coxresults[, adjp2 := p.adjust(pvalues, method = "BH")]
  coxresults[, adjp := p.adjust(pvalues)]
  glmresults[, adjp := p.adjust(pvalues)]

  survivalbiomarkerexportlist <- list(
    coxresults = coxresults,
    survformulas = survformulas,
    glmresults = glmresults,
    glmobjects = glmobjects,
    survivaldat = survivaldat
  )
  survivalbiomarkerexportlist <- setNames(
    survivalbiomarkerexportlist,
    paste0(
      survivalcondition,
      names(survivalbiomarkerexportlist)
    )
  )

  # Keep the complete Patient-level Survival 2 output available to the
  # clinical-adjustment chunk below. Without this collector, only the final
  # survival condition remains in memory after the loop finishes.
  patientlevel_survival2_results[[survivalcondition]] <- list(
    coxresults = copy(coxresults),
    survivaldat = copy(survivaldat)
  )

  filetime <- format(Sys.time(), "%b%e_%H%M")

  save(
    list = names(survivalbiomarkerexportlist),
    envir = list2env(survivalbiomarkerexportlist),
    file = file.path(
      biomarkersavelocation,
      paste(survivalcondition,
        filetime,
        "survivalbiomarkerobjects.RData",
        sep = "_"
      )
    )
  )
  # save_file <- paste0(biomarkersavelocation,
  #                   paste(survivalcondition, filetime, "survivalbiomarkerobjects.RData", sep = "_"))
  #
  # con <- gzfile(save_file, "wb")
  # on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)   # guarantees close even on error
  # save(list = names(survivalbiomarkerexportlist),
  #      envir = list2env(survivalbiomarkerexportlist),
  #      file  = con)
  # close(con)
  # on.exit(NULL)
}
```

```{r adjusted for clinical variables }
unadjusted_alpha <- 0.08

# Clinical covariates: age is continuous; sex, T stage, and grade are factors.
clinical_dt <- as.data.table(copy(TMAs_clinical))[
  case != 999,
  .(case, age, sex, stage, grade)
]
clinical_dt[, case := as.character(case)]
clinical_dt[, age := as.numeric(age)]
clinical_dt[, sex := factor(toupper(trimws(as.character(sex))),
  levels = c("F", "M")
)]
clinical_dt[, stage_code := toupper(gsub("\\s+", "", as.character(stage)))]
clinical_dt[, stage_group := fcase(
  grepl("^T[12]", stage_code), "T1-T2",
  grepl("^T[34]", stage_code), "T3-T4",
  default = NA_character_
)]
clinical_dt[, stage_group := factor(stage_group,
  levels = c("T1-T2", "T3-T4")
)]
clinical_dt[, grade := factor(toupper(trimws(as.character(grade))),
  levels = c("G1", "G2", "G3")
)]

# Collect all nominally significant Patient-level Survival 2 biomarkers.
significant_unadjusted <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(patientlevel_survival2_results), function(condition_name) {
    cox_dt <- patientlevel_survival2_results[[condition_name]]$coxresults

    cox_dt[
      !is.na(pvalues) & pvalues <= unadjusted_alpha,
      .(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        biomarker = conditions,
        endpoint = codes,
        unadjusted_p = pvalues,
        unadjusted_BH_p = adjp2,
        unadjusted_Holm_p = adjp
      )
    ]
  })
)

fit_adjusted_cox <- function(i) {
  result_row <- significant_unadjusted[i]
  condition_name <- result_row$survival_condition
  biomarker_name <- result_row$biomarker
  endpoint_name <- result_row$endpoint

  survival_dt <- patientlevel_survival2_results[[condition_name]]$survivaldat

  model_dt <- survival_dt[, .(
    case = as.character(case),
    time = as.numeric(get(endpoint_name)),
    status = as.numeric(as.character(status)),
    biomarker = get(biomarker_name)
  )]

  model_dt <- merge(
    model_dt,
    clinical_dt[, .(case, age, sex, stage_group, grade)],
    by = "case"
  )
  model_dt <- na.omit(model_dt)
  model_dt[, `:=`(
    biomarker = droplevels(factor(biomarker)),
    sex = droplevels(sex),
    stage_group = droplevels(stage_group),
    grade = droplevels(grade)
  )]

  full_fit <- coxph(
    Surv(time, status) ~ biomarker + age + sex + stage_group + grade,
    data = model_dt,
    ties = "efron"
  )
  reduced_fit <- coxph(
    Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + stage_group + grade,
    data = model_dt,
    ties = "efron"
  )

  comparison <- anova(reduced_fit, full_fit, test = "Chisq")
  biomarker_lrt_p <- as.numeric(
    comparison[nrow(comparison), "Pr(>|Chi|)"]
  )

  fit_summary <- summary(full_fit)
  coef_matrix <- fit_summary$coefficients
  ci_matrix <- fit_summary$conf.int
  biomarker_rows <- grep("^biomarker", rownames(coef_matrix))
  biomarker_coxph_wald_p <- if (length(biomarker_rows) == 1L) {
    as.numeric(coef_matrix[biomarker_rows, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  model_result <- data.table(
    survival_condition = condition_name,
    biomarker = biomarker_name,
    endpoint = endpoint_name,
    unadjusted_p = result_row$unadjusted_p,
    unadjusted_BH_p = result_row$unadjusted_BH_p,
    unadjusted_Holm_p = result_row$unadjusted_Holm_p,
    n = nrow(model_dt),
    events = sum(model_dt$status != 0),
    adjusted_biomarker_LRT_p = biomarker_lrt_p,
    adjusted_biomarker_coxph_Wald_p = biomarker_coxph_wald_p
  )

  coefficient_result <- data.table(
    survival_condition = condition_name,
    biomarker = biomarker_name,
    endpoint = endpoint_name,
    contrast = sub(
      "^biomarker", "",
      rownames(coef_matrix)[biomarker_rows]
    ),
    adjusted_coef = coef_matrix[biomarker_rows, "coef"],
    adjusted_HR = coef_matrix[biomarker_rows, "exp(coef)"],
    adjusted_CI_low = ci_matrix[biomarker_rows, "lower .95"],
    adjusted_CI_high = ci_matrix[biomarker_rows, "upper .95"],
    adjusted_coefficient_p = coef_matrix[biomarker_rows, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )

  list(
    model = model_result,
    coefficients = coefficient_result,
    fit = full_fit,
    data = model_dt
  )
}

adjusted_fit_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(significant_unadjusted)),
  fit_adjusted_cox
)

adjusted_cox_models <- rbindlist(
  lapply(adjusted_fit_list, `[[`, "model")
)
adjusted_cox_coefficients <- rbindlist(
  lapply(adjusted_fit_list, `[[`, "coefficients")
)
adjusted_cox_models[, adjusted_BH_p := p.adjust(
  adjusted_biomarker_LRT_p,
  method = "BH"
)]
adjusted_cox_models[, adjusted_group_FDR_p := p.adjust(
  adjusted_biomarker_LRT_p,
  method = "BH"
), by = survival_condition]
adjusted_cox_significant <- adjusted_cox_models[
  adjusted_biomarker_LRT_p < 0.05
]

clinical_adjusted_output_dir <- file.path(
  BIOMARKER_DIR,
  "clinical adjusted survival2"
)
dir.create(clinical_adjusted_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
adjusted_filetime <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")

fwrite(
  adjusted_cox_models,
  file.path(
    clinical_adjusted_output_dir,
    paste0("clinical_adjusted_cox_models_", adjusted_filetime, ".csv")
  )
)
fwrite(
  adjusted_cox_coefficients,
  file.path(
    clinical_adjusted_output_dir,
    paste0("clinical_adjusted_cox_coefficients_", adjusted_filetime, ".csv")
  )
)
save(
  significant_unadjusted,
  adjusted_cox_models,
  adjusted_cox_coefficients,
  adjusted_cox_significant,
  file = file.path(
    clinical_adjusted_output_dir,
    paste0("clinical_adjusted_survival2_", adjusted_filetime, ".RData")
  )
)
```

```{r sequential clinical covariate adjustment}
sequential_screening_alpha <- 0.05
sequential_adjusted_alpha <- 0.05
combined_origin_conditions <- c("tumor", "Lmet", "LNmet")

# Collect every non-missing Patient-level Survival 2 biomarker test.
sequential_all_biomarkers <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(patientlevel_survival2_results), function(condition_name) {
    cox_dt <- patientlevel_survival2_results[[condition_name]]$coxresults

    cox_dt[
      !is.na(pvalues),
      .(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        biomarker = conditions,
        endpoint = codes,
        screening_p = pvalues,
        screening_BH_p = adjp2,
        screening_Holm_p = adjp
      )
    ]
  })
)

# Retain the existing p < 0.10 screen for entry into adjusted models.
sequential_screened_biomarkers <- sequential_all_biomarkers[
  screening_p < sequential_screening_alpha
]

fit_sequential_clinical_cox <- function(candidate_dt, covariates, model_step) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(candidate_dt)), function(i) {
    candidate <- candidate_dt[i]
    condition_name <- candidate$survival_condition
    biomarker_name <- candidate$biomarker
    endpoint_name <- candidate$endpoint
    model_covariates <- covariates
    if (
      condition_name %chin% combined_origin_conditions &
        length(covariates) > 0
    ) {
      model_covariates <- c(model_covariates, "origin")
    }

    survival_dt <- patientlevel_survival2_results[[condition_name]]$survivaldat

    model_dt <- survival_dt[, .(
      case = as.character(case),
      time = as.numeric(get(endpoint_name)),
      status = as.numeric(as.character(status)),
      biomarker = get(biomarker_name),
      origin = factor(as.character(origin))
    )]

    model_dt <- merge(
      model_dt,
      clinical_dt[, .(case, age, stage_group, grade)],
      by = "case"
    )

    complete_columns <- c(
      "time",
      "status",
      "biomarker",
      model_covariates
    )
    model_dt <- model_dt[
      complete.cases(model_dt[, ..complete_columns])
    ]

    full_formula <- reformulate(
      c("biomarker", model_covariates),
      response = "Surv(time, status)"
    )
    reduced_formula <- reformulate(
      c("1", model_covariates),
      response = "Surv(time, status)"
    )

    full_fit <- coxph(
      full_formula,
      data = model_dt,
      ties = "efron"
    )
    reduced_fit <- coxph(
      reduced_formula,
      data = model_dt,
      ties = "efron"
    )

    comparison <- anova(reduced_fit, full_fit, test = "Chisq")
    biomarker_lrt_p <- as.numeric(
      comparison[nrow(comparison), "Pr(>|Chi|)"]
    )

    fit_summary <- summary(full_fit)
    coefficient_matrix <- fit_summary$coefficients
    confidence_matrix <- fit_summary$conf.int
    biomarker_rows <- grep("^biomarker", rownames(coefficient_matrix))

    data.table(
      survival_condition = condition_name,
      biomarker = biomarker_name,
      endpoint = endpoint_name,
      model_step = model_step,
      covariates = paste(model_covariates, collapse = " + "),
      screening_p = candidate$screening_p,
      screening_BH_p = candidate$screening_BH_p,
      screening_Holm_p = candidate$screening_Holm_p,
      n = nrow(model_dt),
      events = sum(model_dt$status != 0),
      biomarker_LRT_p = biomarker_lrt_p,
      contrast = sub(
        "^biomarker",
        "",
        rownames(coefficient_matrix)[biomarker_rows]
      ),
      coefficient = coefficient_matrix[biomarker_rows, "coef"],
      HR = coefficient_matrix[biomarker_rows, "exp(coef)"],
      CI_low = confidence_matrix[biomarker_rows, "lower .95"],
      CI_high = confidence_matrix[biomarker_rows, "upper .95"],
      coefficient_p = coefficient_matrix[biomarker_rows, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }))
}

add_survival_condition_FDR <- function(result_dt) {
  model_FDR <- unique(result_dt[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    biomarker_LRT_p
  )])
  model_FDR[, biomarker_group_FDR_p := p.adjust(
    biomarker_LRT_p,
    method = "BH"
  ), by = survival_condition]
  result_dt[
    model_FDR,
    on = .(survival_condition, endpoint, biomarker),
    biomarker_group_FDR_p := i.biomarker_group_FDR_p
  ]
  result_dt
}

# Step 0: fit the unadjusted model for every tested biomarker.
unadjusted_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_all_biomarkers,
  covariates = character(0),
  model_step = "Unadjusted p < 0.05"
)
unadjusted_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  unadjusted_step_results
)

# Step 1: add age.
age_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_screened_biomarkers,
  covariates = "age",
  model_step = "Adjusted for age"
)
age_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(age_step_results)

age_significant_biomarkers <- age_step_results[
  biomarker_LRT_p < sequential_adjusted_alpha
]

age_significant_candidates <- unique(
  age_significant_biomarkers[, .(
    survival_condition,
    biomarker,
    endpoint,
    screening_p,
    screening_BH_p,
    screening_Holm_p
  )]
)

# Step 2: retain age-significant biomarkers and add stage group.
age_stage_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  age_significant_candidates,
  covariates = c("age", "stage_group"),
  model_step = "Adjusted for age + stage_group"
)
age_stage_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  age_stage_step_results
)

age_stage_significant_biomarkers <- age_stage_step_results[
  biomarker_LRT_p < sequential_adjusted_alpha
]

age_stage_significant_candidates <- unique(
  age_stage_significant_biomarkers[, .(
    survival_condition,
    biomarker,
    endpoint,
    screening_p,
    screening_BH_p,
    screening_Holm_p
  )]
)

# Step 3: retain age-and-stage-significant biomarkers and add grade.
final_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  age_stage_significant_candidates,
  covariates = c("age", "stage_group", "grade"),
  model_step = "Adjusted for age + stage_group + grade"
)
final_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(final_step_results)

final_biomarkers <- final_step_results[
  biomarker_LRT_p < sequential_adjusted_alpha
]

# Additional parallel covariate models fitted to the same screened biomarkers.
stage_only_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_screened_biomarkers,
  covariates = "stage_group",
  model_step = "Adjusted for stage_group"
)
stage_only_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  stage_only_step_results
)

grade_only_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_screened_biomarkers,
  covariates = "grade",
  model_step = "Adjusted for grade"
)
grade_only_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  grade_only_step_results
)

age_grade_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_screened_biomarkers,
  covariates = c("age", "grade"),
  model_step = "Adjusted for age + grade"
)
age_grade_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  age_grade_step_results
)

grade_stage_step_results <- fit_sequential_clinical_cox(
  sequential_screened_biomarkers,
  covariates = c("grade", "stage_group"),
  model_step = "Adjusted for grade + stage_group"
)
grade_stage_step_results <- add_survival_condition_FDR(
  grade_stage_step_results
)

# Combine the biomarkers recorded at each step with their model parameters.
sequential_clinical_biomarkers <- rbindlist(list(
  unadjusted_step_results[
    screening_p < sequential_screening_alpha
  ],
  age_significant_biomarkers,
  stage_only_step_results,
  grade_only_step_results,
  age_stage_significant_biomarkers,
  age_grade_step_results,
  grade_stage_step_results,
  final_biomarkers
))

sequential_clinical_biomarkers[
  model_step == "Unadjusted p < 0.05",
  covariates := "None"
]
sequential_clinical_biomarkers[, step_number := fcase(
  model_step == "Unadjusted p < 0.05", 0L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for age", 1L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for stage_group", 2L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for grade", 3L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for age + stage_group", 4L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for age + grade", 5L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for grade + stage_group", 6L,
  model_step == "Adjusted for age + stage_group + grade", 7L
)]

setorder(
  sequential_clinical_biomarkers,
  survival_condition,
  endpoint,
  biomarker,
  step_number,
  contrast
)

age_significant_biomarkers
age_stage_significant_biomarkers
final_biomarkers
sequential_clinical_biomarkers
```

```{r biomarker p value trajectories by Cox stratum}
pvalue_trajectory_dir <-
  file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "adjusted")
dir.create(
  pvalue_trajectory_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Include every non-missing Patient-level Survival 2 biomarker at the
# univariate step.
all_screening_trajectory_data <- unique(rbindlist(
  lapply(names(patientlevel_survival2_results), function(condition_name) {
    cox_dt <- patientlevel_survival2_results[[condition_name]]$coxresults

    cox_dt[
      !is.na(pvalues),
      .(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        endpoint = codes,
        biomarker = conditions,
        p_value = pvalues
      )
    ]
  })
))
all_screening_trajectory_data[, model_step := "Univariate"]

# Adjusted steps use the biomarker likelihood-ratio-test p value. Rows absent
# after a step represent biomarkers that were not passed forward.
pvalue_trajectory_data <- rbindlist(list(
  all_screening_trajectory_data,
  unique(age_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Age"],
  unique(stage_only_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Stage"],
  unique(grade_only_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Grade"],
  unique(age_stage_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Age + Stage"],
  unique(age_grade_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Age + Grade"],
  unique(grade_stage_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Grade + Stage"],
  unique(final_step_results[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    p_value = biomarker_LRT_p
  )])[, model_step := "Age + Stage + Grade"]
))

pvalue_trajectory_data[, model_step := factor(
  model_step,
  levels = c(
    "Univariate",
    "Age",
    "Stage",
    "Grade",
    "Age + Stage",
    "Age + Grade",
    "Grade + Stage",
    "Age + Stage + Grade"
  )
)]
pvalue_trajectory_data[, group_FDR_p := p.adjust(
  p_value,
  method = "BH"
), by = .(survival_condition, model_step)]
pvalue_trajectory_data[, biomarker_test_id := paste(
  survival_condition,
  endpoint,
  biomarker,
  sep = " | "
)]

pvalue_trajectory_final_ids <- unique(paste(
  final_biomarkers$survival_condition,
  final_biomarkers$endpoint,
  final_biomarkers$biomarker,
  sep = " | "
))
pvalue_trajectory_data[, final_status := factor(
  fifelse(
    biomarker_test_id %chin% pvalue_trajectory_final_ids,
    "Significant after adjustment",
    "Not significant"
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Not significant",
    "Significant after adjustment"
  )
)]
pvalue_plot_floor <- 0.001
pvalue_trajectory_data[, p_plot := pmax(
  p_value,
  pvalue_plot_floor
)]

pvalue_trajectory_conditions <- unique(
  pvalue_trajectory_data$survival_condition
)

pvalue_trajectory_results <- lapply(
  pvalue_trajectory_conditions,
  function(condition_name) {
    plot_dt <- pvalue_trajectory_data[
      survival_condition == condition_name &
        is.finite(p_plot)
    ]
    first_stage_dt <- copy(plot_dt[
      model_step == "Univariate" &
        final_status == "Significant after adjustment"
    ])
    setorder(first_stage_dt, endpoint, p_plot)
    first_stage_dt[, label_y := 10^(
      log10(pvalue_plot_floor) +
        ((seq_len(.N) - 0.5) / .N) *
          (log10(0.1) - log10(pvalue_plot_floor))
    ), by = endpoint]
    figure_height <- 8

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_dt,
      aes(
        x = as.integer(model_step),
        y = p_plot,
        group = biomarker
      )
    ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0.05,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.7,
        colour = "#C94C4C"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = plot_dt[final_status == "Not significant"],
        aes(colour = final_status),
        linewidth = 0.45,
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = plot_dt[final_status == "Not significant"],
        aes(colour = final_status),
        size = 1.4,
        alpha = 0.55
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = plot_dt[
          final_status == "Significant after adjustment"
        ],
        aes(colour = final_status),
        linewidth = 1.0,
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = plot_dt[
          final_status == "Significant after adjustment"
        ],
        aes(colour = final_status),
        size = 2.2,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      geom_segment(
        data = first_stage_dt,
        aes(
          x = 0.72,
          xend = 0.97,
          y = label_y,
          yend = p_plot
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.25,
        colour = "#2E8B57",
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = first_stage_dt,
        aes(
          x = 0.68,
          y = label_y,
          label = biomarker
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 2.4,
        colour = "#2E8B57",
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        vars(endpoint),
        nrow = 1
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(
          `Not Significant` = "#B8B8B8",
          `Significant after adjustment` = "#2E8B57"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 1:8,
        labels = c(
          "Univariate",
          "Age",
          "Stage",
          "Grade",
          "Age + Stage",
          "Age + Grade",
          "Grade + Stage",
          "Age + Stage + Grade"
        ),
        expand = expansion(add = c(1.8, 0.35))
      ) +
      scale_y_log10(
        breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
        labels = c("<=0.001", "0.01", "0.05", "0.1", "1")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Biomarker p-value trajectories:",
          condition_name
        ),
        subtitle =
          paste(
            "p < 0.001 is displayed at 0.001"
          ),
        x = "Cox model with different covariates",
        y = "Biomarker p value (log10 scale)",
        colour = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          angle = 30,
          hjust = 1
        ),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    figure_file <- file.path(
      pvalue_trajectory_dir,
      paste0(
        condition_name,
        "_biomarker_pvalue_trajectories.png"
      )
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = figure_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 18,
      height = figure_height,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )

    list(
      plot = p,
      summary = data.table(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        biomarkers_tested = uniqueN(plot_dt$biomarker),
        endpoint_biomarker_tests = uniqueN(
          paste(plot_dt$endpoint, plot_dt$biomarker)
        ),
        retained_after_full_adjustment = uniqueN(
          plot_dt[
            final_status == "Significant after adjustment",
            biomarker_test_id
          ]
        ),
        figure_file = figure_file
      )
    )
  }
)
names(pvalue_trajectory_results) <- pvalue_trajectory_conditions

pvalue_trajectory_plots <- lapply(
  pvalue_trajectory_results,
  `[[`,
  "plot"
)
pvalue_trajectory_manifest <- rbindlist(lapply(
  pvalue_trajectory_results,
  `[[`,
  "summary"
))

pvalue_trajectory_manifest
```

```{r four model biomarker p value trajectories}
four_model_trajectory_data[, model_step := factor(

four_model_final_significant_ids <- unique(

four_model_trajectory_data[, full_model_status := factor(

  ),

)]

# Highlight initially significant cell-type proportions that were not retained.
# Spatial-cluster proportions belong to the spatial category, not this category.
four_model_trajectory_data[, is_cell_proportion :=
  grepl("_Percent_(Mean|Median)_Thres$", biomarker) &
    !grepl("^(TME_spatial_|spatialbiomarker)", biomarker)]
four_model_lost_cell_ids <- unique(four_model_trajectory_data[
  model_step == "Univariate" &
    p_value < sequential_screening_alpha &
    is_cell_proportion &
    full_model_status == "Not significant in full model",
  biomarker_test_id
])
four_model_trajectory_data[, plot_status := factor(
  fcase(
    full_model_status == "Significant in full model",
    "Significant in full model",
    biomarker_test_id %chin% four_model_lost_cell_ids,
    "Cell proportion not retained",
    default = "Other biomarkers not retained"
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Significant in full model",
    "Cell proportion not retained",
    "Other biomarkers not retained"
  )
)]
# Match Supplementary Figure 7 panels A-D; omit the pancreas panel.
four_model_plot_conditions <- intersect(
  c("tumor", "Lmet", "LNmet", "SB_origin"),
  pvalue_trajectory_conditions
)

four_model_trajectory_results <- lapply(
  four_model_plot_conditions,
  function(condition_name) {
    plot_dt <- four_model_trajectory_data[
      survival_condition == condition_name &
        is.finite(p_plot)
    ]
    first_stage_dt <- copy(plot_dt[
      model_step == "Univariate" &
        plot_status %chin% c(
          "Significant in full model", "Cell proportion not retained"
        )
    ])
    first_stage_dt[, biomarker_label := sub(
      "_Thres$",
      "",
      biomarker,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )]
    first_stage_dt[, biomarker_label := sub(
      "^patient_?",
      "",
      biomarker_label,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )]
    first_stage_dt[, biomarker_label := sub(
      "^TME_?",
      "",
      biomarker_label,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )]
    setorder(first_stage_dt, endpoint, p_plot)
    first_stage_dt[, label_y := 10^(
      log10(pvalue_plot_floor) +
        ((seq_len(.N) - 0.5) / .N) *
          (log10(0.1) - log10(pvalue_plot_floor))
    ), by = endpoint]
    figure_height <- 8

    trajectory_endpoint_plots <- lapply(
      c("OS", "PFS"),
      function(endpoint_name) {
        endpoint_plot_dt <- plot_dt[endpoint == endpoint_name]
        endpoint_label_dt <- first_stage_dt[endpoint == endpoint_name]
        endpoint_left_expand <- fifelse(
          endpoint_name == "OS",
          4.5,
          6.5
        )
        endpoint_label_size <- fifelse(
          endpoint_name == "OS",
          5,
          4.2
        )

        ggplot(
          endpoint_plot_dt,
          aes(
            x = as.integer(model_step),
            y = p_plot,
            group = biomarker
          )
        ) +
          geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0.05,
            linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.7,
            colour = "#C94C4C"
          ) +
          geom_line(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              plot_status == "Other biomarkers not retained"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            linewidth = 0.45,
            alpha = 0.45
          ) +
          geom_point(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              plot_status == "Other biomarkers not retained"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            size = 1.4,
            alpha = 0.55
          ) +
          geom_line(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              plot_status == "Cell proportion not retained"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            linewidth = 1.0,
            alpha = 0.95
          ) +
          geom_point(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              plot_status == "Cell proportion not retained"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            size = 2.2,
            alpha = 1
          ) +
          geom_line(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              full_model_status == "Significant in full model"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            linewidth = 1.0,
            alpha = 0.95
          ) +
          geom_point(
            data = endpoint_plot_dt[
              full_model_status == "Significant in full model"
            ],
            aes(colour = plot_status),
            size = 2.2,
            alpha = 1
          ) +
          geom_segment(
            data = endpoint_label_dt,
            aes(
              x = 0.72,
              xend = 0.97,
              y = label_y,
              yend = p_plot,
              colour = plot_status
            ),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            linewidth = 0.25,
            alpha = 0.55,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          geom_text(
            data = endpoint_label_dt,
            aes(
              x = 0.68,
              y = label_y,
              label = biomarker_label,
              colour = plot_status
            ),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1,
            size = endpoint_label_size,
            lineheight = 0.9,
            show.legend = FALSE
          ) +
          facet_wrap(
            vars(endpoint),
            nrow = 1
          ) +
          scale_colour_manual(
            values = c(
              `Significant in full model` = "#2E8B57",
              `Cell proportion not retained` = "#727980",
              `Other biomarkers not retained` = "#D5DADF"
            ),
            drop = FALSE
          ) +
          scale_x_continuous(
            breaks = 1:4,
            labels = c(
              "Univariate",
              "Age",
              "Age + Grade",
              "Age + Grade + Stage"
            ),
            expand = expansion(
              add = c(endpoint_left_expand, 0.35)
            )
          ) +
          scale_y_log10(
            limits = c(pvalue_plot_floor, 1),
            breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
            labels = c("<=0.001", "0.01", "0.05", "0.1", "1")
          ) +
          labs(
            x = "Cox model with different covariates",
            y = "Biomarker p value (log10 scale)",
            colour = NULL
          ) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
          theme(
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(
              face = "bold",
              angle = 30,
              hjust = 1
            ),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "bottom"
          )
      }
    )
    names(trajectory_endpoint_plots) <- c("OS", "PFS")
    trajectory_endpoint_plots[["PFS"]] <-
      trajectory_endpoint_plots[["PFS"]] +
      theme(legend.position = "none")

    p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
      trajectory_endpoint_plots[["OS"]],
      trajectory_endpoint_plots[["PFS"]],
      patchwork::guide_area(),
      design = "AB\nCC",
      widths = c(1.15, 0.85),
      heights = c(1, 0.12),
      guides = "collect",
      axes = "collect_y",
      axis_titles = "collect"
    ) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title = paste(
          "Biomarker p-value trajectories:",
          condition_name
        ),
        subtitle = "p < 0.001 is displayed at 0.001",
        theme = theme(
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
        )
      )

    figure_file <- file.path(
      pvalue_trajectory_dir,
      paste0(
        condition_name,
        "_four_model_pvalue_trajectories.png"
      )
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = figure_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 12,
      height = figure_height,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )

    list(
      plot = p,
      summary = data.table(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        biomarkers_tested = uniqueN(plot_dt$biomarker),
        endpoint_biomarker_tests = uniqueN(
          paste(plot_dt$endpoint, plot_dt$biomarker)
        ),
        significant_in_full_model = uniqueN(
          plot_dt[
            full_model_status == "Significant in full model",
            biomarker_test_id
          ]
        ),
        figure_file = figure_file
      )
    )
  }
)
```

```{r final significant biomarker forest plots by Cox stratum}
final_forest_dir <- file.path(
  file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "adjusted"),
  "forest_plots"
)
dir.create(
  final_forest_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

final_forest_full_data <- copy(final_biomarkers[
  is.finite(HR) &
    is.finite(CI_low) &
    is.finite(CI_high) &
    HR > 0 &
    CI_low > 0 &
    CI_high > 0
])
final_forest_full_data[, forest_contrast := fifelse(
  is.na(contrast),
  "",
  as.character(contrast)
)]

final_forest_selected_tests <- unique(final_biomarkers[, .(
  survival_condition,
  endpoint,
  biomarker
)])
final_forest_univariate_data <- copy(unadjusted_step_results[
  final_forest_selected_tests,
  on = .(survival_condition, endpoint, biomarker),
  nomatch = 0
][
  is.finite(HR) &
    is.finite(CI_low) &
    is.finite(CI_high) &
    HR > 0 &
    CI_low > 0 &
    CI_high > 0
])
final_forest_univariate_data[, forest_contrast := fifelse(
  is.na(contrast),
  "",
  as.character(contrast)
)]

final_forest_paired_rows <- merge(
  unique(final_forest_full_data[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    forest_contrast
  )]),
  unique(final_forest_univariate_data[, .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    forest_contrast
  )]),
  by = c(
    "survival_condition",
    "endpoint",
    "biomarker",
    "forest_contrast"
  )
)

final_forest_full_data <- final_forest_full_data[
  final_forest_paired_rows,
  on = .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    forest_contrast
  ),
  nomatch = 0
]
final_forest_full_data[, forest_model := "Age + Grade + Stage"]

final_forest_univariate_data <- final_forest_univariate_data[
  final_forest_paired_rows,
  on = .(
    survival_condition,
    endpoint,
    biomarker,
    forest_contrast
  ),
  nomatch = 0
]
final_forest_univariate_data[, forest_model := "Univariate"]

final_forest_data <- rbindlist(list(
  final_forest_univariate_data,
  final_forest_full_data
), use.names = TRUE)
final_forest_data[, forest_model := factor(
  forest_model,
  levels = c("Univariate", "Age + Grade + Stage")
)]
final_forest_data[, forest_biomarker_label := sub(
  "_Thres$",
  "",
  biomarker,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]
final_forest_data[, forest_biomarker_label := sub(
  "^patient_?",
  "",
  forest_biomarker_label,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]
final_forest_data[, forest_biomarker_label := sub(
  "^TME_?",
  "",
  forest_biomarker_label,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]
final_forest_data[, forest_row_id := paste(
  endpoint,
  biomarker,
  forest_contrast,
  sep = " | "
)]
final_forest_data[, forest_label := fifelse(
  forest_contrast == "",
  forest_biomarker_label,
  paste0(
    forest_biomarker_label,
    ": ",
    forest_contrast
  )
)]
final_forest_data[, full_model_BH_label := formatC(
  biomarker_group_FDR_p,
  format = "e",
  digits = 2
)]

final_forest_conditions <- unique(
  final_forest_data$survival_condition
)

final_forest_results <- lapply(
  final_forest_conditions,
  function(condition_name) {
    condition_dt <- copy(final_forest_data[
      survival_condition == condition_name
    ])
    forest_row_data <- unique(condition_dt[
      forest_model == "Age + Grade + Stage",
      .(
        forest_row_id,
        forest_label,
        endpoint,
        full_model_HR = HR
      )
    ])
    setorder(forest_row_data, endpoint, full_model_HR)
    forest_row_data[, forest_row := rev(seq_len(.N))]
    condition_dt[
      forest_row_data,
      on = "forest_row_id",
      forest_row := i.forest_row
    ]
    condition_dt[, forest_y := forest_row + fifelse(
      forest_model == "Univariate",
      0.13,
      -0.13
    )]
    y_axis_data <- copy(forest_row_data)
    setorder(y_axis_data, forest_row)
    full_model_BH_data <- unique(condition_dt[
      forest_model == "Age + Grade + Stage",
      .(
        forest_row,
        full_model_BH_label
      )
    ])

    forest_range_low <- min(c(condition_dt$CI_low, 1))
    forest_range_high <- max(c(condition_dt$CI_high, 1))
    forest_log_span <- max(
      log10(forest_range_high) - log10(forest_range_low),
      1
    )
    full_model_BH_x <- 10^(
      log10(forest_range_high) + 0.15 * forest_log_span
    )
    forest_x_low <- 10^(
      log10(forest_range_low) - 0.05 * forest_log_span
    )
    forest_x_high <- 10^(
      log10(forest_range_high) + 0.55 * forest_log_span
    )

    p <- ggplot(
      condition_dt,
      aes(y = forest_y)
    ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 1,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.7,
        colour = "#666666"
      ) +
      geom_segment(
        aes(
          x = CI_low,
          xend = CI_high,
          yend = forest_y,
          colour = endpoint
        ),
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(
          x = HR,
          colour = endpoint,
          shape = forest_model
        ),
        size = 3.2
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = full_model_BH_data,
        aes(
          x = full_model_BH_x,
          y = forest_row,
          label = full_model_BH_label
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        hjust = 0,
        size = 3.4,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = full_model_BH_x,
        y = nrow(forest_row_data) + 0.65,
        label = "BH q",
        hjust = 0,
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 3.6
      ) +
      scale_x_log10(
        limits = c(forest_x_low, forest_x_high)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = y_axis_data$forest_row,
        labels = y_axis_data$forest_label,
        limits = c(0.5, nrow(forest_row_data) + 0.9),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
      ) +
      scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(
        Univariate = 18,
        `Age + Grade + Stage` = 16
      )) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Significant biomarkers:",
          condition_name
        ),
        x = "Hazard ratio (log scale)",
        y = NULL,
        colour = "Endpoint",
        shape = "Model"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
      )

    figure_file <- file.path(
      final_forest_dir,
      paste0(
        condition_name,
        "_fully_adjusted_significant_biomarker_forest.png"
      )
    )
    figure_height <- max(6, 0.42 * nrow(forest_row_data) + 2.5)
    ggsave(
      filename = figure_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = figure_height,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )

    list(
      plot = p,
      summary = data.table(
        survival_condition = condition_name,
        significant_biomarker_tests = uniqueN(paste(
          condition_dt$endpoint,
          condition_dt$biomarker
        )),
        forest_rows = nrow(forest_row_data),
        figure_file = figure_file
      )
    )
  }
)
names(final_forest_results) <- final_forest_conditions

final_forest_plots <- lapply(
  final_forest_results,
  `[[`,
  "plot"
)
final_forest_manifest <- rbindlist(lapply(
  final_forest_results,
  `[[`,
  "summary"
))

final_forest_manifest
```

```{r intersample correlation }
# -- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
.select_cols <- function(dt, cols) {
  if (length(cols) == 2L && all(cols %in% names(dt)) && match(
    cols[1],
    names(dt)
  ) <= match(
    cols[2],
    names(dt)
  )) {
    i1 <- match(cols[1], names(dt)); i2 <- match(cols[2], names(dt))
    return(names(dt)[i1:i2])
  }
  # otherwise treat as explicit vector
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(dt))
  if (length(miss)) stop("Columns not found: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  cols
}

.numeric_only <- function(dt, cols) {
  num <- cols[sapply(cols, function(x) is.numeric(dt[[x]]))]
  dropped <- setdiff(cols, num)
  if (length(dropped)) warning("Dropping non-numeric columns: ", paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))
  num
}

# core worker for a single x/y vector; returns list
.cor_worker <- function(x, y, method, slope_type) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < 3L) {
    return(list(
      n = n, cor = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, conf_low = NA_real_, conf_high = NA_real_,
      K = NA_real_, b = NA_real_, r_squared = NA_real_, trend = "none"
    ))
  }
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]

  # correlation & test
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95))
  r <- unname(ct$estimate); p <- unname(ct$p.value)
  ci <- if (!is.null(ct$conf.int)) unname(ct$conf.int) else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)

  # slope options
  if (slope_type == "rank") {
    xr <- rank(x, ties.method = "average"); yr <- rank(y, ties.method = "average")
    fit <- lm(yr ~ xr)
  } else { # "ols"
    fit <- lm(y ~ x)
  }
  co <- coef(fit)
  K <- unname(co[2]); b <- unname(co[1]); r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared

  list(
    n = n, cor = r, p_value = p, conf_low = ci[1], conf_high = ci[2],
    K = K,
    b = b,
    r_squared = r2,
    trend = ifelse(is.na(r),
      "none",
      ifelse(r > 0,
        "increasing",
        ifelse(r < 0,
          "decreasing",
          "none"
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

# -- main --------------------------------------------------------------------
correlate_dt2 <- function(
  dt,
  cols, # vector of names or c(start, end)
  method = c("pearson", "spearman"),
  by = character(0), # e.g., c("ROI") or c("case","origin")
  mode = c("pairwise", "target"),
  target = NULL, # string or vector when mode="target"
  na_method = c("pairwise", "complete"),
  slope_type = c("ols", "rank"), # "rank" = slope on ranks
  p_adjust = c("none", "BH", "bonferroni", "holm", "BY", "hochberg", "hommel")
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(dt))
  method <- match.arg(method)
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  na_method <- match.arg(na_method)
  slope_type <- match.arg(slope_type)
  p_adjust <- match.arg(p_adjust)

  use_arg <- if (na_method == "pairwise") "pairwise.complete.obs" else "complete.obs"

  sel <- .select_cols(dt, cols)
  sel <- .numeric_only(dt, sel)
  if (length(sel) < 2L) stop("Need at least two numeric columns after filtering.")

  # build (x,y) pairs
  if (mode == "target") {
    if (is.null(target)) stop("Provide target when mode='target'.")
    targets <- intersect(
      if (length(target) == 2L && all(target %in% names(dt))) .select_cols(
        dt,
        target
      ) else target,
      sel
    )
    if (!length(targets)) stop("No valid targets among selected columns.")
    xs <- setdiff(sel, targets)
    combs <- CJ(var_x = xs, var_y = targets, unique = TRUE)
  } else {
    cm <- utils::combn(sel, 2); combs <- data.table(var_x = cm[1, ], var_y = cm[2, ])
  }

  # fast path: Pearson + pairwise + no CI needed could use cor() matrix
  # but we keep a unified path for clarity; optimize later if needed.

  run_group <- function(gdt) {
    combs[,
      {
        w <- .cor_worker(gdt[[var_x]], gdt[[var_y]], method = method, slope_type = slope_type)
        c(list(var_x = var_x, var_y = var_y), w)
      },
      by = seq_len(nrow(combs))
    ][, seq_len := NULL][]
  }

  if (length(by)) {
    miss_by <- setdiff(by, names(dt))
    if (length(miss_by)) stop("Grouping columns not found: ", paste(miss_by, collapse = ", "))
    res <- dt[, run_group(.SD), by = by]
  } else {
    res <- run_group(dt)
  }

  if (length(by)) {
    data.table::setorderv(res, c(by, "var_x", "var_y"))
  } else {
    data.table::setorder(res, "var_x", "var_y")
  }
  # adjust p-values within each group (if grouped), else globally
  if (length(by)) {
    res[, p_adj := p.adjust(p_value, method = p_adjust), by = by]
  } else {
    res[, p_adj := p.adjust(p_value, method = p_adjust)]
  }

  # metadata
  res[, `:=`(method = method, slope_type = slope_type, use = use_arg, adjust = p_adjust)]
  setcolorder(res, intersect(c(
    by, "method", "use", "adjust", "slope_type", "var_x", "var_y",
    "n", "cor", "p_value", "p_adj", "conf_low", "conf_high", "K", "b", "r_squared", "trend"
  ), names(res)))
  if (length(by)) {
    data.table::setorderv(res, c(by, "var_x", "var_y"))
  } else {
    data.table::setorderv(res, c("var_x", "var_y"))
  }
  res[]
}
```

```{r lm plots}
# 1) Data & keys
dtC <- data_in[Phenotype == "Cancer"]
setkey(dtC, case, tissue)

# 2) Classify trends from correlation_results (once)
alpha <- 0.05
sel_all <- copy(correlation_results)
sel_all[, p_adj := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p_adj))]
sel_all[, cor := as.numeric(cor)]
sel_all <- sel_all[!tissue %in% c("C", "O", "N")]
sel_all[
  ,
  group := fifelse(
    cor < 0 & p_adj <= alpha,
    "Neg_sig",
    fifelse(
      cor > 0 & p_adj <= alpha,
      "Pos_sig",
      "Not_sig"
    )
  )
][
  , pair := sprintf("%s vs %s", var_y, var_x)
]

tissues_to_plot <- unique(sel_all$tissue) # e.g., "T", "Liver", etc.

# helper: one panel for (pair, group, tissue), pooled across CASES
make_panel <- function(pr, grp, ti, x, y) {
  keys <- unique(sel_all[pair == pr & tissue == ti & group == grp, .(case, tissue)])
  if (!nrow(keys)) {
    return(ggplot() +
      annotate("text",
        x = .5, y = .5,
        label = paste("No", grp, "for tissue", ti), size = 5
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle(grp))
  }
  pts <- dtC[keys, nomatch = 0L]
  if (!nrow(pts) || !all(c(x, y) %in% names(pts))) {
    return(ggplot() +
      annotate("text",
        x = .5, y = .5,
        label = paste("No data for", grp), size = 5
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle(grp))
  }

  d <- pts[is.finite(get(x)) & is.finite(get(y)), .(xv = get(x), yv = get(y))]
  if (nrow(d) < 3L) {
    return(ggplot() +
      annotate("text",
        x = .5, y = .5,
        label = paste("Insufficient data for", grp), size = 5
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      ggtitle(grp))
  }

  fit <- try(suppressWarnings(lm(yv ~ xv, data = d)), silent = TRUE)
  a <- b <- NA_real_
  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    cf <- coef(fit); a <- unname(cf[1]); b <- unname(cf[2])
  }

  # hx <- max(1e-6, stats::bw.nrd0(d$xv))
  # hy <- max(1e-6, stats::bw.nrd0(d$yv))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = xv, y = yv)) +
    geom_density_2d_filled(alpha = 0.5, contour_var = "ndensity", n = 100, breaks = seq(0.002, 1, by = 0.01)) +
    # geom_point()+
    # geom_density_2d(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "blue", n=100,  contour_var = "ndensity", breaks = seq(0.001, 0.09, by = 0.01))+
    geom_abline(intercept = a, slope = b, linewidth = 0.7) +
    labs(title = grp, x = x, y = y) +
    guides(fill = "none")
}

# 3) Iterate per pairwise correlation, then per tissue, and merge 3 panels
out_root <- file.path(BIOMARKER_DIR, "Lm plots/faceted_by_tissue_trend")
if (!dir.exists(out_root)) dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE)

for (pr in unique(sel_all$pair)) {
  # get var names for labels
  labs_xy <- sel_all[pair == pr][1L, .(x = var_x, y = var_y)]
  if (!nrow(labs_xy)) next
  x <- labs_xy$x; y <- labs_xy$y

  for (ti in tissues_to_plot) {
    p_neg <- make_panel(pr, "Neg_sig", ti, x, y)
    p_pos <- make_panel(pr, "Pos_sig", ti, x, y)
    p_not <- make_panel(pr, "Not_sig", ti, x, y)

    p_merged <- (p_neg | p_pos | p_not) +
      plot_annotation(title = sprintf("tissue=%s — %s (pooled across cases)", ti, pr))

    # save
    safe <- function(s) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", s)
    out_dir <- file.path(out_root, sprintf("tissue_%s", safe(ti)))
    if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    fpath <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("merged3_%s_%s.png", safe(ti), safe(pr)))
    ggsave(fpath, p_merged, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r per patient correlation quardant plot}
plot_slide_quadrant <- function(
  slide_dat,
  correlation_results,
  x_col,
  y_col,
  id_col = "slide",
  cor_x_col = "var_x",
  cor_y_col = "var_y",
  cor_group_col = "corr_group",
  x_thres = c("median", "mean"),
  y_thres = c("median", "mean"),
  title = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  point_size = 2.8,
  alpha = 0.85,
  add_bg = TRUE,
  label_size = 3.2
) {
  x_thres <- match.arg(x_thres)
  y_thres <- match.arg(y_thres)

  slide_dat <- as.data.table(copy(slide_dat))
  correlation_results <- as.data.table(copy(correlation_results))

  # ── 1. check columns ─────────────────────────────────────
  req_slide_cols <- c(id_col, x_col, y_col)
  miss_slide <- setdiff(req_slide_cols, names(slide_dat))
  if (length(miss_slide) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in slide_dat: ", paste(miss_slide, collapse = ", "))
  }

  req_cor_cols <- c(id_col, cor_x_col, cor_y_col, cor_group_col)
  miss_cor <- setdiff(req_cor_cols, names(correlation_results))
  if (length(miss_cor) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in correlation_results: ", paste(miss_cor, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # ── 2. pick matching correlation rows ────────────────────
  to_corr_density_name <- function(x) {
    x <- sub("_meandensity$", ".density", x)
    x <- sub("_density$", ".density", x)
    x
  }

  to_corr_protein_name <- function(x) {
    x <- sub("^Cancer_?", "", x)
    x <- sub("_?mean$", "", x)
    x
  }

  var_x_match <- to_corr_density_name(x_col)
  var_y_match <- to_corr_protein_name(y_col)

  current_ids <- unique(slide_dat[[id_col]])

  cor_sub <- correlation_results[
    get(id_col) %in% current_ids &
      get(cor_x_col) == var_x_match &
      get(cor_y_col) == var_y_match,
    .SD,
    .SDcols = c(id_col, cor_group_col)
  ]

  if (nrow(cor_sub) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No matching rows in correlation_results for: ",
      x_col, " vs ", y_col,
      "\nConverted to: ", var_x_match, " vs ", var_y_match
    )
  }

  cor_sub <- unique(cor_sub, by = id_col)

  # ── 3. merge ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  plot_dat <- merge(
    slide_dat,
    cor_sub,
    by = id_col,
    all.x = FALSE,
    all.y = FALSE
  )

  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(get(x_col)) &
      !is.na(get(y_col)) &
      !is.na(get(cor_group_col))
  ]

  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {
    stop("No complete cases after merging.")
  }

  # ── 4. threshold values ──────────────────────────────────
  x_thres_val <- if (x_thres == "median") {
    median(plot_dat[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    mean(plot_dat[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  y_thres_val <- if (y_thres == "median") {
    median(plot_dat[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    mean(plot_dat[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # ── 5. group factor ──────────────────────────────────────
  plot_dat[, group_plot := factor(
    get(cor_group_col),
    levels = c("neg_sig", "not_sig", "pos_sig")
  )]

  if (is.null(title)) title <- paste(x_col, "vs", y_col)
  if (is.null(xlab)) xlab <- x_col
  if (is.null(ylab)) ylab <- y_col

  # ── 6. plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]], color = group_plot)
  )

  if (add_bg) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = x_thres_val, xmax = Inf,
        ymin = y_thres_val, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "#BC3C2920"
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = -Inf, xmax = x_thres_val,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = y_thres_val,
        fill = "#0072B520"
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = x_thres_val,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = y_thres_val,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = alpha) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = "Low / High",
      hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
      size = label_size, color = "gray35", fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = "High / High",
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
      size = label_size, color = "gray35", fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf, y = -Inf,
      label = "Low / Low",
      hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
      size = label_size, color = "gray35", fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      label = "High / Low",
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      size = label_size, color = "gray35", fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0(xlab, "\n(", x_thres, " = ", round(x_thres_val, 3), ")"),
      y = paste0(ylab, "\n(", y_thres, " = ", round(y_thres_val, 3), ")"),
      title = title,
      color = "Correlation group"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 35, b = 30, l = 35)
    ) +
    ggsci::scale_color_nejm(drop = FALSE)

  return(p)
}

p <- plot_slide_quadrant(
  slide_dat = case_dat,
  correlation_results = correlation_patients,
  x_col = "Fibro_meandensity",
  y_col = "CancerTGFBmean",
  x_thres = "median",
  y_thres = "median",
  id_col = "case",
  title = "Fibro density vs Cancer TGFB"
)

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "TGFB_VS_Fibro_perpatient.png")),
  plot = p, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```
